sec01-card-sec01-F01.front: Which four credential types make operating a motor vehicle on Wyoming roads lawful?
sec01-card-sec01-F01.expected_back: Legal driving in Wyoming requires a valid driver license, instruction permit, intermediate license or restricted license.

sec01-card-sec01-F02.front: Which program and agency issue driver licenses in Wyoming?
sec01-card-sec01-F02.expected_back: Wyoming's Driver Services Program within WYDOT issues the state's driver licenses.

sec01-card-sec01-F03.front: When may federal employees drive in Wyoming without obtaining a Wyoming driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F03.expected_back: Federal employees need no Wyoming license when they operate vehicles owned or leased by the United States government.

sec01-card-sec01-F04.front: What licensing exemption covers active-duty military personnel stationed in Wyoming along with their dependents?
sec01-card-sec01-F04.expected_back: Armed Forces members stationed in Wyoming and their dependents need no Wyoming license while holding a valid license from their home state.

sec01-card-sec01-F05.front: When are full-time college or university students in Wyoming excused from getting a Wyoming driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F05.expected_back: Full-time students at the University of Wyoming or a Wyoming community college need no Wyoming license if their other-state license is valid.

sec01-card-sec01-F06.front: Within what period of establishing Wyoming residency must a driver from another Driver License Compact state surrender that license?
sec01-card-sec01-F06.expected_back: A driver licensed in another Driver License Compact state may initially use that license in Wyoming, but must surrender it within one year of Wyoming residency.

sec01-card-sec01-F07.front: Can someone obtain a Wyoming license while suspended, canceled, denied, or revoked in another state?
sec01-card-sec01-F07.expected_back: A person with driving privileges suspended, canceled, denied or revoked in any state is ineligible for a Wyoming license.

sec01-card-sec01-F08.front: What happens to your license application if you fail any mandatory part of the driver examination?
sec01-card-sec01-F08.expected_back: Failing any required portion of the driver-license examination prevents an applicant from receiving the license.

sec01-card-sec01-F09.front: How does a court determination of legal incompetence affect Wyoming driver-license eligibility?
sec01-card-sec01-F09.expected_back: A person judged legally incompetent is among those ineligible for a Wyoming license.

sec01-card-sec01-F10.front: Under what age does the manual's general ineligibility list bar a standard driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F10.expected_back: The handbook's general ineligibility list includes people younger than sixteen.

sec01-card-sec01-F11.front: How does habitual use of alcohol affect eligibility for a Wyoming driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F11.expected_back: Habitual alcohol use appears among the handbook's listed reasons for license ineligibility.

sec01-card-sec01-F12.front: How does violating federal immigration laws affect an application for a Wyoming driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F12.expected_back: A violation of United States immigration laws is a listed barrier to obtaining a Wyoming license.

sec01-card-sec01-F13.front: Does a standard noncommercial Class C Wyoming license authorize you to ride a motorcycle?
sec01-card-sec01-F13.expected_back: The noncommercial Class C category described here excludes motorcycle operation.

sec01-card-sec01-F14.front: Below what Gross Vehicle Weight Rating must a single vehicle or combination stay under a noncommercial Class C license?
sec01-card-sec01-F14.expected_back: For the Class C vehicle category described in the handbook, the single vehicle or combination must have a GVWR below twenty-six thousand one pounds.

sec01-card-sec01-F33.front: Under the noncommercial Class C towing rule, what is the maximum GVWR allowed for the towed unit?
sec01-card-sec01-F33.expected_back: In the Class C towing category described here, the towed vehicle's GVWR must not exceed ten thousand pounds.

sec01-card-sec01-F15.front: Which two fundamental categories of proof must an applicant present to get a Wyoming license?
sec01-card-sec01-F15.expected_back: An applicant must supply legal identity and Wyoming-residency evidence to obtain a Wyoming license.

sec01-card-sec01-F16.front: Which three examinations make up Wyoming's standard driver-licensing test trio?
sec01-card-sec01-F16.expected_back: The licensing process requires knowledge, vision and driving-skills examinations.

sec01-card-sec01-F17.front: What extra signed authorization is required from a parent or legal guardian when an applicant is under eighteen?
sec01-card-sec01-F17.expected_back: An applicant younger than eighteen also needs a release signed by a legal parent or guardian.

sec01-card-sec01-F18.front: At what age does Wyoming's standard instruction permit become available?
sec01-card-sec01-F18.expected_back: An instruction permit is available starting at age fifteen.

sec01-card-sec01-F19.front: At what age do limited solo driving privileges become available under a Wyoming intermediate license?
sec01-card-sec01-F19.expected_back: Limited driving privileges through an intermediate license are available at age sixteen.

sec01-card-sec01-F20.front: Which three primary documents can establish legal identification for a first-time Wyoming license or ID applicant?
sec01-card-sec01-F20.expected_back: A first-time license or ID applicant must provide a state-certified birth certificate, valid United States passport or immigration documents as legal identification.

sec01-card-sec01-F21.front: What extra documentation is required if your current last name does not match your primary identity document?
sec01-card-sec01-F21.expected_back: If the applicant's last name differs from the verification document, proof of the name change is required.

sec01-card-sec01-F22.front: Which three official records can prove a legal name change at the licensing counter?
sec01-card-sec01-F22.expected_back: A marriage certificate, divorce decree or court order can document an applicant's name change.

sec01-card-sec01-F23.front: Which documents are accepted to verify an applicant's Social Security number?
sec01-card-sec01-F23.expected_back: Applicants must verify their Social Security number with a Social Security card, W-two form or financial or banking statement displaying that number.

sec01-card-sec01-F24.front: How soon and in what form must a Wyoming license holder report a change of address?
sec01-card-sec01-F24.expected_back: A license holder who changes address must notify the department in writing within ten days.

sec01-card-sec01-F25.front: How many residency documents are required in Wyoming, and why won't a PO Box qualify?
sec01-card-sec01-F25.expected_back: Wyoming residency proof requires two acceptable documents showing a residential address rather than a post-office box.

sec01-card-sec01-F26.front: When can a vehicle title or registration count toward proving Wyoming residency?
sec01-card-sec01-F26.expected_back: Vehicle title or registration documents are acceptable evidence of Wyoming residence when they show the residential address.

sec01-card-sec01-F27.front: Which four housing-related documents can establish Wyoming residency when they show your physical address?
sec01-card-sec01-F27.expected_back: Property-tax, mortgage, rental or lease documents can establish Wyoming residency when they show the residential address.

sec01-card-sec01-F28.front: Can federal tax paperwork count as one of your Wyoming residency proofs?
sec01-card-sec01-F28.expected_back: Federal tax documents with a Wyoming address are among the accepted residency proofs.

sec01-card-sec01-F29.front: When do statements from a Wyoming bank or credit union qualify as residency evidence?
sec01-card-sec01-F29.expected_back: Statements from a Wyoming bank or credit union may serve as residency proof if they show the residential address.

sec01-card-sec01-F30.front: Beyond the specific examples, what broader category of paperwork may Driver Services accept for residency?
sec01-card-sec01-F30.expected_back: Other legal documents showing a Wyoming residential address may also be accepted as residency evidence.

sec01-card-sec01-F31.front: What two-eye visual acuity score is required to pass Wyoming's standard vision screening?
sec01-card-sec01-F31.expected_back: Wyoming's vision standard requires twenty over forty acuity using both eyes, with or without glasses.

sec01-card-sec01-F32.front: At least how many degrees of combined horizontal visual field does Wyoming require?
sec01-card-sec01-F32.expected_back: The required combined horizontal visual field is at least one hundred twenty degrees.

sec01-card-sec01-R01.front: What vehicle limitation does Restriction A place on a Wyoming driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-R01.expected_back: Restriction A limits driving to an automatic transmission.

sec01-card-sec01-R02.front: What does Restriction B require whenever the license holder is behind the wheel?

sec01-card-sec01-R03.front: What driving equipment does Restriction C indicate on a Wyoming license?
sec01-card-sec01-R03.expected_back: Restriction C indicates a required mechanical aid.

sec01-card-sec01-R04.front: What personal assistive device does Restriction D signify on a Wyoming license?
sec01-card-sec01-R04.expected_back: Restriction D indicates a required prosthetic aid.

sec01-card-sec01-R05.front: To what hours does Restriction G confine a Wyoming motorist's driving?
sec01-card-sec01-R05.expected_back: Restriction G limits driving to daylight.

sec01-card-sec01-R06.front: How does the Wyoming manual define Restriction I on a driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-R06.expected_back: Restriction I is labeled as a limitation covering other circumstances.

sec01-card-sec01-R07.front: What special credential status does Restriction J mark on a Wyoming license?
sec01-card-sec01-R07.expected_back: Restriction J marks a license valid without a photograph or signature.

sec01-card-sec01-R08.front: To what specific vehicle type does Restriction R limit operation?
sec01-card-sec01-R08.expected_back: Restriction R limits operation to a four-wheel recreational vehicle.

sec01-card-sec01-R09.front: What step must an applicant take after failing the counter vision screening?
sec01-card-sec01-R09.expected_back: A person who fails vision screening must obtain a vision statement from an eye specialist.

sec01-card-sec01-R10.front: If you use eyeglasses or contacts to pass WYDOT's eye check, what rule follows on the road?
sec01-card-sec01-R10.expected_back: Glasses or contact lenses used to pass vision screening must also be used while driving.

sec01-card-sec01-R11.front: Within what visual-acuity range worse than 20 over 40 must an applicant pass a driving-skills test?
sec01-card-sec01-R11.expected_back: An applicant whose visual acuity is worse than twenty over forty but at least twenty over one hundred must take a driving-skills test.

sec01-card-sec01-R12.front: Where do all questions on Wyoming's written knowledge exam come from?
sec01-card-sec01-R12.expected_back: The written exam draws its questions from the information in the Wyoming driver manual.

sec01-card-sec01-R13.front: Which three visual features must you recognize to identify traffic signs on the written exam?
sec01-card-sec01-R13.expected_back: Written testing includes recognition of traffic signs by their shape, color or symbol.

sec01-card-sec01-R14.front: Alongside road signs, which two roadway control systems are tested on the written knowledge exam?
sec01-card-sec01-R14.expected_back: Signals and pavement markings are subjects of the written test.

sec01-card-sec01-R15.front: Which four core subject areas do Wyoming's written multiple-choice questions cover?
sec01-card-sec01-R15.expected_back: Written multiple-choice questions address traffic laws, safety rules, crash prevention and vehicle equipment.

sec01-card-sec01-R16.front: At most how many times may an applicant take the written knowledge exam in a single day?
sec01-card-sec01-R16.expected_back: A driver-license applicant may take the written test at most twice during one day.

sec01-card-sec01-R17.front: In what language are Wyoming tests given, and what option exists for applicants who cannot speak or write English?
sec01-card-sec01-R17.expected_back: Although tests are given only in English, an interpreter may be used when an applicant cannot speak or write English.

sec01-card-sec01-R18.front: When must an applicant ask if they need an oral version of the knowledge test?
sec01-card-sec01-R18.expected_back: An applicant seeking an oral test must request it before testing.

sec01-card-sec01-R19.front: What behind-the-wheel requirement applies to a first-time applicant never licensed in any state?
sec01-card-sec01-R19.expected_back: A first-time applicant never licensed in Wyoming or any other state must pass a skills test of safe driving maneuvers.

sec01-card-sec01-R20.front: Will a Wyoming examiner ever ask you to perform an illegal traffic move during a skills test?
sec01-card-sec01-R20.expected_back: The skills test does not require an applicant to perform an illegal maneuver.

sec01-card-sec01-R21.front: Can WYDOT require a driving test in situations beyond brand-new first-time licensing?
sec01-card-sec01-R21.expected_back: Other circumstances may require a driving test to demonstrate driving ability.

sec01-card-sec01-R22.front: How long must you wait to retake the driving-skills exam after failing an attempt?
sec01-card-sec01-R22.expected_back: A skills-test applicant who fails must wait twenty-four hours before trying again.

sec01-card-sec01-R23.front: What document from an approved driver-education course can waive the WYDOT driving-skills exam?
sec01-card-sec01-R23.expected_back: An approved driver-education completion certification card may allow the skills test to be waived.

sec01-card-sec01-R24.front: Which three student identifiers must appear on a driver-education completion certification card?
sec01-card-sec01-R24.expected_back: The driver-education certification card must list the student's name, birth date and driver-license number.

sec01-card-sec01-R25.front: Whose two original signatures must appear on a valid driver-education certification card?
sec01-card-sec01-R25.expected_back: The certification card must carry the instructor's and school administrator's original signatures.

sec01-card-sec01-R26.front: How many classroom hours and behind-the-wheel hours must a driver-education card confirm?
sec01-card-sec01-R26.expected_back: The certification card must confirm thirty classroom hours and six hours of behind-the-wheel instruction.

sec01-card-sec01-R27.front: For how long is a Wyoming driver-education completion certification card honored?
sec01-card-sec01-R27.expected_back: A driver-education certification card is honored for no more than two years.

sec02-card-sec02-F01.front: Which three tests must first-time Wyoming license applicants pass when no skills waiver applies?
sec02-card-sec02-F01.expected_back: First Wyoming license applicants must pass the knowledge test, vision screening and driving-skills test unless an applicable waiver excuses the skills test.

sec02-card-sec02-F02.front: Which two credentials can excuse a first-time Wyoming applicant from taking the driving-skills exam?
sec02-card-sec02-F02.expected_back: A valid out-of-state license or a certificate from an approved driver-education course may support a waiver of the driving-skills test.

sec02-card-sec02-F03.front: What signed form must accompany a first-license application when the applicant is under eighteen?
sec02-card-sec02-F03.expected_back: A first-license applicant under eighteen needs a minor's release signed by a legal parent or guardian.

sec02-card-sec02-F04.front: Which two screenings should you arrive ready to pass when applying for an instruction permit?
sec02-card-sec02-F04.expected_back: Instruction-permit applicants should be ready for the written knowledge test and vision screening.

sec02-card-sec02-F05.front: Who must sit in the front passenger seat alongside an instruction-permit driver?
sec02-card-sec02-F05.expected_back: An instruction-permit driver must have a licensed supervisor aged eighteen or older in the front passenger seat, licensed for the vehicle type being driven.

sec02-card-sec02-F06.front: Who qualifies for a standard Wyoming driver-license renewal?
sec02-card-sec02-F06.expected_back: A Wyoming citizen holding a valid Wyoming license may receive a renewal.

sec02-card-sec02-F07.front: How early before expiration may a license holder over twenty-one renew?
sec02-card-sec02-F07.expected_back: License holders over twenty-one may renew during the one hundred twenty days before their license expires.

sec02-card-sec02-F08.front: Within what pre-expiration window may a license holder under twenty-one renew according to the manual?
sec02-card-sec02-F08.expected_back: License holders under twenty-one may renew within the ninety-day expiration window stated in the handbook.

sec02-card-sec02-F09.front: How close to turning twenty-one must an under-21 holder wait to renew into an adult-style horizontal license?
sec02-card-sec02-F09.expected_back: An applicant under twenty-one who wants an adult-style license may renew only within thirty days of the twenty-first birthday.

sec02-card-sec02-F10.front: Which screening is mandatory at renewal, and what extra test may an examiner require?
sec02-card-sec02-F10.expected_back: Renewal applicants must pass vision screening, and an examiner may also require a skills test.

sec02-card-sec02-F11.front: How often may a current Wyoming driver license be renewed by mail?
sec02-card-sec02-F11.expected_back: A current Wyoming license may be renewed by mail only on alternating renewal periods.

sec02-card-sec02-F12.front: What happens if you let your Wyoming driver license expire before renewing?
sec02-card-sec02-F12.expected_back: A person whose license has expired must apply for a new one in person and may need all examination phases again.

sec02-card-sec02-F31.front: How many days before expiration does WYDOT mail renewal packets to drivers over 21 versus under 21?
sec02-card-sec02-F31.expected_back: Renewal-by-mail applications are sent one hundred twenty days before expiration to people over twenty-one and ninety days before expiration to people under twenty-one.

sec02-card-sec02-F32.front: To which address does WYDOT send renewal-by-mail packets?
sec02-card-sec02-F32.expected_back: Renewal-by-mail applications go to the current address in the department's records.

sec02-card-sec02-F13.front: At what age can a Wyoming teen earn full driving privileges even without holding a prior permit or license?
sec02-card-sec02-F13.expected_back: At age seventeen, an applicant may receive full Wyoming driving privileges without previously holding a license or permit.

sec02-card-sec02-F14.front: Can a seventeen-year-old upgrade to a full license while restricted driving privileges are suspended?
sec02-card-sec02-F14.expected_back: A seventeen-year-old cannot receive the full license described here while current restricted driving privileges are suspended.

sec02-card-sec02-F15.front: What core verification document requirement applies to a seventeen-year-old applying for full privileges?
sec02-card-sec02-F15.expected_back: The full-license applicant aged seventeen must provide identity evidence.

sec02-card-sec02-F16.front: Which three tests must an applicant pass to gain full Wyoming driving privileges directly at age seventeen?
sec02-card-sec02-F16.expected_back: The applicant seeking full privileges at seventeen must pass vision, written and driving-skills tests.

sec02-card-sec02-F17.front: What three conditions allow a teen to earn full Wyoming driving privileges early at age sixteen and a half?
sec02-card-sec02-F17.expected_back: At age sixteen and one-half, full driving privileges may be issued to an applicant with a current intermediate license at least six months old, no suspension of current restricted privileges and approved driver education.

sec02-card-sec02-F18.front: What kind of driver-education certificate qualifies a teen for the sixteen-and-a-half full-license route?
sec02-card-sec02-F18.expected_back: The younger full-license route requires a signed completion certificate for a Wyoming Department of Education-approved driver-education course that includes behind-the-wheel training.

sec02-card-sec02-F19.front: Which two counter checks must the sixteen-and-a-half full-license applicant complete?
sec02-card-sec02-F19.expected_back: The applicant using the younger full-license route must prove identity and pass vision screening.

sec02-card-sec02-F20.front: What parental signature and payment complete the sixteen-and-a-half full-license application?
sec02-card-sec02-F20.expected_back: The younger full-license applicant needs a parent or legal guardian to sign the Minor's Release Form and must pay the required fee.

sec02-card-sec02-F21.front: At what ages and under what family circumstance may Wyoming issue a restricted hardship license?
sec02-card-sec02-F21.expected_back: A restricted license may be issued at ages fourteen or fifteen when the applicant's household has an extreme inconvenience.

sec02-card-sec02-F22.front: What prior permit and minimum commute distance are required to qualify for a restricted license?
sec02-card-sec02-F22.expected_back: The restricted-license applicant must have held an instruction permit and live at least five miles from school or employment.

sec02-card-sec02-F23.front: Which agency investigates and approves restricted-license hardship applications in Wyoming?
sec02-card-sec02-F23.expected_back: The Wyoming Highway Patrol approves restricted-license applications.

sec02-card-sec02-F24.front: Between what daily clock hours may a 14- or 15-year-old restricted-license holder drive?
sec02-card-sec02-F24.expected_back: This restricted license permits driving only between five a.m. and eight p.m.

sec02-card-sec02-F25.front: How far from home may a restricted-license holder legally drive?
sec02-card-sec02-F25.expected_back: The restricted license limits driving to within fifty miles of the holder's home.

sec02-card-sec02-F26.front: How many moving-traffic convictions does it take to suspend a 14- or 15-year-old's restricted license?
sec02-card-sec02-F26.expected_back: One moving-traffic conviction causes suspension of this restricted license.

sec02-card-sec02-F27.front: What happens if a restricted-license holder drives past 8 PM, before 5 AM, or beyond 50 miles from home?
sec02-card-sec02-F27.expected_back: Driving outside the restricted license's permitted hours or distance boundary causes suspension.

sec02-card-sec02-F28.front: When does a restricted hardship license automatically expire?
sec02-card-sec02-F28.expected_back: A restricted license expires thirty days after the holder turns sixteen.

sec02-card-sec02-F29.front: Who can get a restricted instruction permit at age fourteen or fifteen?
sec02-card-sec02-F29.expected_back: A restricted instruction permit is available at ages fourteen or fifteen to an approved restricted-license applicant who does not already hold an instruction permit.

sec02-card-sec02-F30.front: How long is a Wyoming restricted instruction permit valid?
sec02-card-sec02-F30.expected_back: A restricted instruction permit lasts sixty days.

sec02-card-sec02-R01.front: At what minimum age can a teen receive a Wyoming intermediate driver license?
sec02-card-sec02-R01.expected_back: An intermediate license may be issued when the applicant reaches age sixteen.

sec02-card-sec02-R02.front: How can holding a Restricted Class C license help a sixteen-year-old qualify for an intermediate license?
sec02-card-sec02-R02.expected_back: Holding a Restricted Class C license is one route to intermediate-license eligibility.

sec02-card-sec02-R03.front: How many total and nighttime driving hours must a parent or guardian certify on the instruction-permit path to an intermediate license?
sec02-card-sec02-R03.expected_back: The instruction-permit route to an intermediate license requires fifty hours behind the wheel, including ten nighttime hours, certified by a parent or legal guardian.

sec02-card-sec02-R04.front: Which two basic counter requirements must every intermediate-license applicant satisfy?
sec02-card-sec02-R04.expected_back: An intermediate-license applicant must present identity evidence and pass vision screening.

sec02-card-sec02-R05.front: When may an intermediate-license applicant skip the WYDOT driving-skills test?
sec02-card-sec02-R05.expected_back: An intermediate applicant must pass a driving-skills test unless that test is waived after completion of an approved driver-education course.

sec02-card-sec02-R06.front: What payment and signed parental document are required to issue an intermediate license?
sec02-card-sec02-R06.expected_back: The intermediate-license applicant must pay the required fee and obtain a minor's release signed by a parent or legal guardian.

sec02-card-sec02-R07.front: How many non-family passengers under eighteen may ride with an unsupervised intermediate-license driver?
sec02-card-sec02-R07.expected_back: An intermediate-license driver may carry at most one passenger under eighteen who is not immediate family unless a licensed driver aged eighteen or older is also present.

sec02-card-sec02-R08.front: Who must wear a seat belt inside a vehicle driven by an intermediate-license holder?
sec02-card-sec02-R08.expected_back: An intermediate-license holder must make sure every occupant wears a seat belt.

sec02-card-sec02-R09.front: Between what overnight hours is an intermediate driver barred from driving without a signed exception form?
sec02-card-sec02-R09.expected_back: An intermediate-license driver may drive between eleven p.m. and five a.m. only when an exception applies and a completed exception form is presented.

sec02-card-sec02-R10.front: Who must certify a medical necessity to qualify an intermediate driver for overnight driving?
sec02-card-sec02-R10.expected_back: A medical necessity certified by medical personnel can qualify an intermediate-license driver for a night-driving exception.

sec02-card-sec02-R11.front: How does a job commute between 11 PM and 5 AM qualify under the intermediate night restriction?
sec02-card-sec02-R11.expected_back: An employer-certified trip to or from work can qualify for the intermediate-license night-driving exception.

sec02-card-sec02-R12.front: Which four youth activities qualify for an overnight exception when certified by a parent or guardian?
sec02-card-sec02-R12.expected_back: Trips to or from school, school activities, organized youth sports or religious activities can qualify for the night-driving exception when certified by a parent or legal guardian.

sec02-card-sec02-R13.front: How can an unexpected medical emergency qualify under the intermediate night-driving rule?
sec02-card-sec02-R13.expected_back: A medical emergency evidenced by medical personnel can qualify for the intermediate-license night-driving exception.

sec02-card-sec02-R14.front: Who must fill out and sign the intermediate driver's overnight exception form?
sec02-card-sec02-R14.expected_back: The person appropriate to the claimed exception must complete and sign the intermediate driver's exception form.

sec02-card-sec02-R15.front: Where must the signed overnight exception form be kept while an intermediate driver travels after 11 PM?
sec02-card-sec02-R15.expected_back: An intermediate driver using an exception must carry the signed form and show it to law enforcement if stopped.

sec02-card-sec02-R16.front: What suspension length follows violating intermediate passenger, belt, or curfew rules?
sec02-card-sec02-R16.expected_back: A violation of the intermediate-license provisions causes a thirty-day suspension.

sec03-card-sec03-F01.front: When does a Wyoming intermediate license automatically expire?
sec03-card-sec03-F01.expected_back: An intermediate license expires automatically thirty days after its holder's seventeenth birthday.

sec03-card-sec03-F02.front: What clinician document may Driver Services require before licensing an applicant with a disability?
sec03-card-sec03-F02.expected_back: Before licensing an applicant with a disability, Driver Services may require a physician-completed medical or vision statement.

sec03-card-sec03-F03.front: How must WYDOT handle license restrictions recommended for safe driving by an applicant's doctor or eye specialist?
sec03-card-sec03-F03.expected_back: When needed for safe vehicle operation, WYDOT must license the applicant with restrictions recommended by the applicant's physician, optometrist or ophthalmologist.

sec03-card-sec03-F04.front: Besides medical paperwork, what in-person evaluation can add safety restrictions for an applicant with a disability?
sec03-card-sec03-F04.expected_back: A skills test may also lead to restrictions needed for a disabled applicant to operate safely.

sec03-card-sec03-F05.front: Which Wyoming agency coordinates police, Weather Service, broadcasters, and WYDOT during an Amber Alert?
sec03-card-sec03-F05.expected_back: The Wyoming Division of Criminal Investigation serves as liaison among local law enforcement, the National Weather Service, broadcasters and DOT for Amber Alerts.

sec03-card-sec03-F06.front: How many of the listed activation criteria must be met before an Amber Alert can go out?
sec03-card-sec03-F06.expected_back: An Amber Alert can be activated only after every listed activation criterion has been met.

sec03-card-sec03-F07.front: What core incident type is mandatory before law enforcement can trigger an Amber Alert?
sec03-card-sec03-F07.expected_back: An abducted child is a required condition for an Amber Alert.

sec03-card-sec03-F08.front: What age requirement must an abducted child meet under Wyoming's Amber Alert rules?
sec03-card-sec03-F08.expected_back: The abducted child must be seventeen or younger for the listed Amber Alert criteria.

sec03-card-sec03-F09.front: What degree of threat must the abducted child face to activate an Amber Alert?
sec03-card-sec03-F09.expected_back: The child must face immediate danger of serious bodily harm or death for an Amber Alert.

sec03-card-sec03-F10.front: Why must investigators have enough descriptive details before launching an Amber Alert?
sec03-card-sec03-F10.expected_back: Amber Alert activation requires enough descriptive information to support a belief that broadcasting can help recovery.

sec03-card-sec03-F11.front: What should drivers do whenever an Amber Alert flashes on overhead boards or radio?
sec03-card-sec03-F11.expected_back: When an Amber Alert is activated, motorists should pay attention to its information.

sec03-card-sec03-F12.front: How does WYDOT maintain driving histories for licensed motorists across Wyoming?
sec03-card-sec03-F12.expected_back: WYDOT keeps a computerized driving record for each driver in the state.

sec03-card-sec03-F13.front: Which two enforcement items appear on a motorist's computerized WYDOT driving record?
sec03-card-sec03-F13.expected_back: The driving record includes convictions and adverse actions resulting from convictions.

sec03-card-sec03-F14.front: How can you pick up a copy of your own driving record at a local exam station?
sec03-card-sec03-F14.expected_back: A driver can obtain a personal driving-record copy at a local examination station by providing a license or other legal identification and paying the fee.

sec03-card-sec03-F15.front: Until what age may a legal parent or guardian obtain a minor child's Wyoming driving record?
sec03-card-sec03-F15.expected_back: A legal parent or guardian may obtain a child's driving record while the child is under eighteen.

sec03-card-sec03-F16.front: What authorization must someone present to an examiner to obtain another adult's driving record?
sec03-card-sec03-F16.expected_back: To obtain another person's driving record, a requester must present that person's written release to the examiner.

sec03-card-sec03-F17.front: How can you order your own driving record from WYDOT without visiting an exam station?
sec03-card-sec03-F17.expected_back: A person may request a personal driving record by sending the department a written request with the required fee.

sec03-card-sec03-F18.front: What contact details must accompany a written driving-record request if you want to pay by credit card?
sec03-card-sec03-F18.expected_back: A credit-card payment request for a driving record must be stated in the written request with a phone number and email address for contact.

sec03-card-sec03-F19.front: What three commercial uses of driver data does the federal Driver's Privacy Protection Act block?
sec03-card-sec03-F19.expected_back: The federal Driver's Privacy Protection Act bars WYDOT from supplying personal information for surveys, marketing or solicitations.

sec03-card-sec03-F20.front: Which five items on file count as protected personal information under the manual's privacy rules?
sec03-card-sec03-F20.expected_back: Photographs, digital images, signatures, phone numbers and medical or disability information are personal information under the privacy discussion.

sec03-card-sec03-F21.front: Which three safety or status categories are not blocked from lawful release under the privacy discussion?
sec03-card-sec03-F21.expected_back: The privacy discussion does not prohibit release of records about crashes, driving violations or license and registration status.

sec03-card-sec03-F22.front: What life-saving registration question appears on Wyoming driver-license and ID applications?
sec03-card-sec03-F22.expected_back: Wyoming license and ID applications ask whether the applicant wants to register as an organ donor.

sec03-card-sec03-F23.front: How does WYDOT share an applicant's choice to become an organ donor?
sec03-card-sec03-F23.expected_back: DOT is authorized to send donor-status information electronically to the Donor Registry.

sec03-card-sec03-F24.front: What extra approval is needed when an applicant under eighteen chooses to register as an organ donor?
sec03-card-sec03-F24.expected_back: For a donor under eighteen, a parent or guardian must sign to approve the anatomical gift.

sec03-card-sec03-F25.front: How is an organ donor's choice indicated on their finished Wyoming driver license or ID card?
sec03-card-sec03-F25.expected_back: A person who chooses organ donation receives a donor designation on the driver license or ID card.

sec03-card-sec03-R09.front: Why might an applicant request a voluntary medical-condition designation on a license or ID?
sec03-card-sec03-R09.expected_back: A license or ID applicant may choose a medical-condition designation for first responders or law enforcement when the person cannot communicate the condition.

sec03-card-sec03-R10.front: Where does a voluntary medical-alert designation appear once selected?
sec03-card-sec03-R10.expected_back: A chosen medical-alert designation appears on the driver license or ID card.

sec03-card-sec03-R11.front: Can you update or remove a voluntary medical-alert designation later, and how?
sec03-card-sec03-R11.expected_back: Medical-alert designation information can be changed or removed at any time by contacting Driver Services.

sec03-card-sec03-R12.front: What voluntary conservation contribution can applicants make when applying for a Wyoming license or ID?
sec03-card-sec03-R12.expected_back: License and ID applicants may choose a wildlife-conservation donation.

sec03-card-sec03-R13.front: How is a voluntary wildlife-conservation donation recorded and paid at the counter?
sec03-card-sec03-R13.expected_back: A wildlife-conservation donor records the chosen amount on the application, and the examiner collects it with the other fees.

sec03-card-sec03-R01.front: How long must a physical impairment last to qualify for a permanent disabled parking placard?
sec03-card-sec03-R01.expected_back: For a permanent disabled placard, the physical impairment must last at least twelve months.

sec03-card-sec03-R02.front: Up to how many months of impairment does a temporary disabled parking placard cover?
sec03-card-sec03-R02.expected_back: A temporary disabled placard may be issued for an impairment lasting up to six months.

sec03-card-sec03-R03.front: Where can you pick up disabled parking placard application forms in person?
sec03-card-sec03-R03.expected_back: Disabled-placard application forms are available at driver-license examination stations.

sec03-card-sec03-R04.front: Who must complete the medical certification on a disabled parking placard application?
sec03-card-sec03-R04.expected_back: A physician must complete the disabled-placard application.

sec03-card-sec03-R05.front: Which form do you use if you want disabled metal license plates instead of only a hanging placard?
sec03-card-sec03-R05.expected_back: An applicant seeking disabled plates must use the placard application and indicate the request for license plates.

sec03-card-sec03-R06.front: If an eligible person receives disabled license plates, how many hanging placards may they also hold?
sec03-card-sec03-R06.expected_back: A person may receive one disabled placard together with one or more sets of plates.

sec03-card-sec03-R07.front: How many disabled placards may an eligible person receive when choosing zero disabled license plates?
sec03-card-sec03-R07.expected_back: As an alternative, a person may receive two disabled placards and no license plates.

sec03-card-sec03-R08.front: How much does Wyoming charge an eligible applicant for disabled parking placards?
sec03-card-sec03-R08.expected_back: The handbook states that disabled placards are provided without a charge to the applicant.

sec04-card-sec04-F01.front: What chemical-test alcohol concentration following a DWUI arrest triggers an Administrative Per Se suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-F01.expected_back: An arrest for DWUI followed by a chemical-test alcohol concentration of at least zero point zero eight percent triggers an Administrative Per Se suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-F02.front: Does having your criminal DWUI charge dismissed in court cancel the Administrative Per Se suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-F02.expected_back: Dismissing the court DWUI case does not undo the Administrative Per Se suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-F03.front: How long does an Administrative Per Se suspension last in Wyoming?
sec04-card-sec04-F03.expected_back: The Administrative Per Se suspension lasts ninety days.

sec04-card-sec04-F04.front: If a court DWUI conviction follows, how is time already served on the Administrative Per Se suspension treated?
sec04-card-sec04-F04.expected_back: If a DWUI conviction follows, time served on the Administrative Per Se suspension is credited toward the DWUI suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-F05.front: When does an Administrative Per Se suspension take effect after the officer hands over the notice and temporary license?
sec04-card-sec04-F05.expected_back: An Administrative Per Se suspension begins thirty days after the officer issues the temporary license and suspension notice, or after an existing suspension or revocation ends.

sec04-card-sec04-F06.front: Which two administrative procedures does the arresting officer's suspension form explain how to request?
sec04-card-sec04-F06.expected_back: The officer's form explains how to seek limited privileges or a contested-case hearing after the administrative action.

sec04-card-sec04-F07.front: Which two conditions disqualify an otherwise eligible driver from getting limited privileges during an Administrative Per Se suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-F07.expected_back: Limited privileges after Administrative Per Se action may be available only to an otherwise eligible driver without a probationary license issued in the previous five years or an ignition-interlock requirement.

sec04-card-sec04-F08.front: What two steps are required to reinstate your license after an Administrative Per Se suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-F08.expected_back: Administrative Per Se reinstatement requires completing every suspension action on record and paying the reinstatement fee.

sec04-card-sec04-F09.front: What court outcome triggers Wyoming's criminal DWUI suspension category?
sec04-card-sec04-F09.expected_back: The DWUI suspension category described here follows a court conviction for driving under the influence.

sec04-card-sec04-F10.front: Under which Wyoming statute can a DWUI case result in deferred prosecution?
sec04-card-sec04-F10.expected_back: A DWUI case may also result in deferred prosecution under W.S. seven-thirteen-three hundred one.

sec04-card-sec04-F11.front: What lookback window and suspension length apply to a first court DWUI offense?
sec04-card-sec04-F11.expected_back: A first DWUI offense within the previous ten years carries a ninety-day suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-F12.front: How do the Administrative Per Se suspension and first-offense court DWUI suspension interact?
sec04-card-sec04-F12.expected_back: For that first DWUI, an Administrative Per Se suspension already served or being served uses the same suspension period.

sec04-card-sec04-F13.front: Who may qualify for limited driving privileges after a first DWUI conviction?
sec04-card-sec04-F13.expected_back: Limited privileges for a first DWUI may be available to an otherwise eligible driver without a probationary license in the past five years or an interlock requirement.

sec04-card-sec04-F14.front: At what arrest BAC on a first DWUI must the driver hold an interlock-restricted license for six months?
sec04-card-sec04-F14.expected_back: For a first DWUI with arrest BAC at least zero point one five percent, the driver must hold an interlock-restricted license for six months before another license type is available.

sec04-card-sec04-F15.front: What suspension or interlock option satisfies the first item on Wyoming's first-DWUI reinstatement checklist?
sec04-card-sec04-F15.expected_back: The first-DWUI reinstatement checklist allows completion of suspension actions or, when arrest BAC is at least zero point one five percent, an interlock-restricted application supported by installation proof.

sec04-card-sec04-F16.front: Which insurance filing and payment complete the first-DWUI reinstatement checklist?
sec04-card-sec04-F16.expected_back: The first-DWUI reinstatement checklist also requires an SR-twenty-two filing and payment of the reinstatement fee.

sec04-card-sec04-F17.front: What suspension length applies to a second DWUI offense within ten years?
sec04-card-sec04-F17.expected_back: A second DWUI within the previous ten years carries a one-year suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-F18.front: On a second DWUI where the 90-day Per Se suspension was served or started, how much suspension is added?
sec04-card-sec04-F18.expected_back: For that second DWUI, an Administrative Per Se suspension already served or underway is followed by an additional nine-month suspension on the record.

sec04-card-sec04-F19.front: How long must a driver hold an interlock-restricted license after a second alcohol-involved DWUI conviction?
sec04-card-sec04-F19.expected_back: A second alcohol-involved DWUI conviction requires an interlock-restricted license for one year before eligibility for another license type.

sec04-card-sec04-F20.front: What licensing penalty hits upon a third DWUI conviction inside a ten-year span?
sec04-card-sec04-F20.expected_back: A third or later DWUI offense within ten years carries a three-year revocation.

sec04-card-sec04-F21.front: What ignition-interlock term applies upon a fourth or subsequent alcohol-involved DWUI conviction?
sec04-card-sec04-F21.expected_back: A fourth or later alcohol-involved DWUI conviction brings a lifetime interlock-restricted-license requirement.

sec04-card-sec04-F22.front: How soon after conviction may a driver with a lifetime interlock mandate petition the court for removal?
sec04-card-sec04-F22.expected_back: A driver with that lifetime interlock requirement may petition the court for removal five years after the conviction date.

sec04-card-sec04-F23.front: What completion or interlock option starts the reinstatement checklist after a third or later DWUI?
sec04-card-sec04-F23.expected_back: The third-or-later DWUI reinstatement checklist includes completing suspension or revocation actions or, when required, applying for an interlock-restricted license with installation proof.

sec04-card-sec04-F24.front: Which financial-responsibility form and payment are required on the third-or-later DWUI checklist?
sec04-card-sec04-F24.expected_back: The third-or-later DWUI reinstatement checklist requires filing an SR-twenty-two and paying the reinstatement fee.

sec04-card-sec04-F25.front: What clinical screening is required to reinstate after a third or subsequent DWUI?
sec04-card-sec04-F25.expected_back: Reinstatement after a third or later DWUI requires an alcohol or drug evaluation.

sec04-card-sec04-F26.front: Beyond an evaluation, what program milestone is required for third-or-later DWUI reinstatement?
sec04-card-sec04-F26.expected_back: Reinstatement after a third or later DWUI requires successful completion of an alcohol or drug treatment program.

sec04-card-sec04-F27.front: What driving-ability requirement appears on the third-or-later DWUI checklist unless waived by clean interlock history?
sec04-card-sec04-F27.expected_back: The third-or-later DWUI reinstatement checklist calls for passing a re-examination of safe vehicle operation, subject to the stated interlock-license waiver.

sec04-card-sec04-F28.front: What ongoing restriction and compliance duty can attach when relicensed after repeat DWUIs?
sec04-card-sec04-F28.expected_back: A driver relicensed after the repeat-DWUI process may receive a no-alcohol-or-substance-abuse-offenses restriction and must follow the counselor's recommendations.

sec04-card-sec04-F29.front: What reward applies if a repeat-DWUI driver holds an interlock-restricted license with zero violations?
sec04-card-sec04-F29.expected_back: When an interlock-restricted license has been obtained without violations, the repeat-DWUI re-examination and additional restriction may be waived.

sec04-card-sec04-F30.front: At what alcohol concentration does a driver under twenty-one in actual physical control face youthful-driver DWUI suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-F30.expected_back: A driver under twenty-one who has actual physical control of a vehicle with alcohol concentration at least zero point zero two percent is subject to the youthful-driver DWUI suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-F31.front: How long is the license suspension for a first youthful-driver DWUI offense?
sec04-card-sec04-F31.expected_back: The first youthful-driver DWUI offense carries a ninety-day suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-F32.front: What lookback period and suspension length apply to a second or later youthful-driver DWUI?
sec04-card-sec04-F32.expected_back: A second or later youthful-driver DWUI offense within two years carries a six-month suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-F33.front: When can a suspended driver in the youthful-driver DWUI category qualify for limited privileges?
sec04-card-sec04-F33.expected_back: Limited privileges in the youthful-driver category may be available to an otherwise eligible applicant with no probationary license in the previous five years and no interlock requirement.

sec04-card-sec04-F34.front: What arrest BAC on a first youthful-driver offense triggers a six-month interlock-restricted license?
sec04-card-sec04-F34.expected_back: For the first youthful-driver offense with arrest BAC at least zero point one five percent, an interlock-restricted license must be held for six months before another license type.

sec04-card-sec04-F35.front: What interlock requirement follows a second alcohol-involved youthful-driver DWUI conviction?
sec04-card-sec04-F35.expected_back: A second youthful-driver DWUI conviction involving alcohol requires one year holding an interlock-restricted license before another license type becomes available.

sec04-card-sec04-F36.front: How does the Wyoming manual define the driving conduct behind a reckless-driving conviction?
sec04-card-sec04-F36.expected_back: A reckless-driving suspension follows a conviction for operating a vehicle with willful or wanton disregard for people or property safety.

sec04-card-sec04-F37.front: What lookback window and suspension length apply to a first reckless-driving conviction?
sec04-card-sec04-F37.expected_back: A first reckless-driving offense within the previous five years carries a ninety-day suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-F38.front: When may a driver convicted of a first reckless-driving offense obtain limited driving privileges?
sec04-card-sec04-F38.expected_back: Limited privileges after that first reckless-driving offense may be available if the person is otherwise eligible and has had no probationary license in the past five years.

sec04-card-sec04-F39.front: What suspension length follows a second reckless-driving conviction within five years?
sec04-card-sec04-F39.expected_back: A second reckless-driving offense within the previous five years carries a six-month suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-F40.front: Are limited driving privileges still possible after a second reckless-driving offense within five years?
sec04-card-sec04-F40.expected_back: Limited privileges after a second reckless-driving offense may be available to an otherwise eligible person without a probationary license in the past five years.

sec04-card-sec04-F41.front: Which three requirements apply to reinstate your license after a second reckless-driving offense?
sec04-card-sec04-F41.expected_back: Second-offense reckless-driving reinstatement requires completing all suspension actions, filing an SR-twenty-two and paying the reinstatement fee.

sec04-card-sec04-F42.front: What penalty hits upon a third or subsequent reckless-driving offense within five years?
sec04-card-sec04-F42.expected_back: A third or later reckless-driving offense within five years causes a one-year revocation.

sec04-card-sec04-F43.front: Can a driver revoked for a third or later reckless-driving offense get limited driving privileges?
sec04-card-sec04-F43.expected_back: The third-or-later reckless-driving category does not allow limited driving privileges.

sec04-card-sec04-F44.front: Which four steps are required to get relicensed after a third or later reckless-driving revocation?
sec04-card-sec04-F44.expected_back: Third-or-later reckless-driving reinstatement requires completion of recorded suspension or revocation actions, an SR-twenty-two, the reinstatement fee and a passed safe-driving re-examination.

sec04-card-sec04-F45.front: What vehicle-related alcohol offense involving someone under twenty-one triggers a dedicated suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-F45.expected_back: A conviction involving intent to furnish alcoholic liquor or malt beverage to someone under twenty-one while operating or occupying a motor vehicle triggers the transporting-liquor-to-a-minor suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-F46.front: How long is the license suspension for transporting liquor with intent to furnish a minor?
sec04-card-sec04-F46.expected_back: The transporting-liquor-to-a-minor suspension lasts one year.

sec04-card-sec04-F47.front: Who may qualify for limited privileges during a transporting-liquor-to-a-minor suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-F47.expected_back: Limited privileges after the transporting-liquor conviction may be available to an otherwise eligible person who has had no probationary license in the last five years.

sec04-card-sec04-F48.front: What two requirements apply to reinstate after a transporting-liquor-to-a-minor suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-F48.expected_back: Reinstatement after the transporting-liquor suspension requires completion of all suspension actions and payment of the reinstatement fee.

sec04-card-sec04-R01.front: What interstate compact suspension triggers when a court reports you failed to satisfy a traffic citation?
sec04-card-sec04-R01.expected_back: A court report that a driver has not met a traffic citation's terms can trigger a Non-Resident Violator Compact suspension for either Wyoming or other-state citations.

sec04-card-sec04-R02.front: Under the Non-Resident Violator Compact, which state actually suspends the driver's license?
sec04-card-sec04-R02.expected_back: In a Non-Resident Violator Compact case, the licensing state takes suspension action rather than the state where the violation happened.

sec04-card-sec04-R03.front: How long does a citation-related Non-Resident Violator Compact suspension remain active?
sec04-card-sec04-R03.expected_back: The citation-related suspension continues until the court supplies satisfaction notice and the reinstatement fee is paid.

sec04-card-sec04-R04.front: Can you obtain limited probationary driving privileges during a Non-Resident Violator Compact suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-R04.expected_back: Limited privileges are unavailable for the Non-Resident Violator Compact suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-R05.front: What happens if the court sends satisfaction notice before the citation-related suspension start date arrives?
sec04-card-sec04-R05.expected_back: Before the citation-related suspension starts, court notice that the citation requirements are satisfied causes deletion of the suspension from the record.

sec04-card-sec04-R06.front: What two items are required once a citation-related suspension has already taken effect?
sec04-card-sec04-R06.expected_back: After the citation-related suspension starts, reinstatement requires both the court's satisfaction notice and the reinstatement fee.

sec04-card-sec04-R07.front: How many moving-violation convictions within twelve months trigger a ninety-day Wyoming suspension notice?
sec04-card-sec04-R07.expected_back: A fourth moving-violation conviction within a twelve-month period triggers notice of a ninety-day suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-R08.front: What happens for each additional moving violation after the fourth within that same twelve-month window?
sec04-card-sec04-R08.expected_back: Each additional moving violation within the twelve-month period produces another ninety-day suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-R09.front: Does Wyoming's moving-violation twelve-month lookback count from the ticket offense date or the court conviction date?
sec04-card-sec04-R09.expected_back: Moving-violation lookbacks use the offense date rather than a later conviction date.

sec04-card-sec04-R10.front: How does the manual define a moving violation, and do license-restriction convictions count?
sec04-card-sec04-R10.expected_back: A moving violation involves control or lack of control while the vehicle is moving and results in conviction, including conviction for violating a license restriction.

sec04-card-sec04-R11.front: What triggers Wyoming's compulsory-insurance license suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-R11.expected_back: A court conviction for lacking liability insurance triggers the compulsory-insurance suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-R12.front: Until what document is filed does a compulsory-insurance suspension stay in force?
sec04-card-sec04-R12.expected_back: A compulsory-insurance suspension lasts until an SR-twenty-two insurance form is filed with the department.

sec04-card-sec04-R13.front: Are limited probationary privileges available during a compulsory-insurance suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-R13.expected_back: Limited privileges are unavailable for a compulsory-insurance suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-R14.front: What happens if you file an SR-22 before a compulsory-insurance suspension's effective date?
sec04-card-sec04-R14.expected_back: Filing an SR-twenty-two before a compulsory-insurance suspension starts removes that suspension from the record.

sec04-card-sec04-R15.front: What two items are required if you wait until after a compulsory-insurance suspension starts?
sec04-card-sec04-R15.expected_back: After a compulsory-insurance suspension starts, reinstatement requires an SR-twenty-two filing and the reinstatement fee.

sec04-card-sec04-R16.front: What licensing action can result from displaying or using someone else's driver license or ID card?
sec04-card-sec04-R16.expected_back: Displaying or using another person's license or ID card can lead to unlawful-use suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-R17.front: What happens if you possess a driver license or ID card that has been altered or tampered with?
sec04-card-sec04-R17.expected_back: Possessing an altered or tampered-with license or ID card can trigger unlawful-use suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-R18.front: Is it legal to lend your own Wyoming license or ID card to a friend for identification?
sec04-card-sec04-R18.expected_back: Lending a license or ID card for another person to use as identification is unlawful.

sec04-card-sec04-R19.front: What rule governs making false statements, giving a fake name, or hiding facts on a license or ID application?
sec04-card-sec04-R19.expected_back: Knowingly supplying false statements, fictitious information or a false name, or concealing a fact, is unlawful on a license or ID application.

sec04-card-sec04-R20.front: Which four personal identifiers belonging to someone else is it unlawful to put on a license or ID application?
sec04-card-sec04-R20.expected_back: Using another person's name, address, Social Security number or birth date on a license or ID application is unlawful.

sec04-card-sec04-R21.front: What administrative penalties can hit someone who misuses or lends a driver license or ID card?
sec04-card-sec04-R21.expected_back: The listed license or ID misuse can result in card cancellation, a ninety-day suspension for the person using or lending it, or both.

sec04-card-sec04-R22.front: What dollar amount and duration of unpaid child support trigger a DFS license suspension notice?
sec04-card-sec04-R22.expected_back: A DFS notice that child-support arrears of at least five thousand dollars have persisted for ninety consecutive days triggers child-support suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-R23.front: What DFS clearance and WYDOT payment are required to end a child-support suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-R23.expected_back: Ending a child-support suspension requires DFS notification of full compliance or an approved payment plan, together with payment of the reinstatement fee.

sec04-card-sec04-R24.front: How long is the suspension for a first moving-violation conviction committed on a restricted Class RC license?
sec04-card-sec04-R24.expected_back: A moving-violation conviction committed while holding a restricted Class RC license causes a ninety-day suspension for the first offense.

sec04-card-sec04-R25.front: What suspension length follows a second or later moving conviction while holding a restricted Class RC license?
sec04-card-sec04-R25.expected_back: A second or later moving-violation conviction while holding that restricted Class RC license causes a one-year suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-R26.front: How many days is an intermediate license suspended for violating passenger, seat-belt, or curfew restrictions?
sec04-card-sec04-R26.expected_back: Violating an intermediate-license restriction causes a thirty-day suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-R27.front: What extra suspension hits a driver under twenty-one caught driving while suspended, revoked, or canceled?
sec04-card-sec04-R27.expected_back: For a driver under twenty-one, driving while privileges are suspended, revoked or canceled causes a further thirty-day suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-R28.front: When does Wyoming impose an uninsured-accident suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-R28.expected_back: An uninsured-accident suspension results when the driver's insurance cannot be verified at the time of the crash.

sec04-card-sec04-R29.front: What notarized statement from the other crash parties can resolve an uninsured-accident suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-R29.expected_back: An uninsured driver may submit the other crash parties' notarized release stating that they do not hold the driver liable for damage or injury, or that restitution has been made.

sec04-card-sec04-R30.front: How does a conditional release resolve an uninsured crash when damages aren't paid upfront in full?
sec04-card-sec04-R30.expected_back: Another uninsured-crash option is a conditional release signed and notarized by the driver and the other parties stating an agreement to pay for damage or injury.

sec04-card-sec04-R31.front: How is the cash-deposit amount calculated if an uninsured driver posts security instead of a release?
sec04-card-sec04-R31.expected_back: An uninsured driver may instead post a cash deposit covering total property damage plus twenty-five thousand dollars for each injury.

sec04-card-sec04-R32.front: When and under what condition can an uninsured-crash cash deposit be refunded?
sec04-card-sec04-R32.expected_back: The uninsured-crash cash deposit may be refunded one year after the crash only if there are no judgments against the driver.

sec04-card-sec04-R33.front: What option opens one year after an uninsured crash if you could neither get a release nor post cash?
sec04-card-sec04-R33.expected_back: An uninsured driver unable to provide the listed release or deposit options may submit a signed, notarized affidavit one year after the crash stating that no resulting judgments remain unsatisfied.

sec04-card-sec04-R34.front: Alongside a release, deposit, or one-year affidavit, what two extra items are required after an uninsured-crash suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-R34.expected_back: A driver suspended after the uninsured-crash process must also pay the reinstatement fee and file an SR-twenty-two in addition to satisfying a listed crash-resolution option.

sec04-card-sec04-R35.front: What formal review does an eligible suspended driver request to seek a limited probationary license?
sec04-card-sec04-R35.expected_back: An otherwise eligible suspended driver may request a Record Review for possible issuance of a probationary license allowing limited privileges.

sec04-card-sec04-R36.front: Within how many days of the suspension notice date must a written Record Review request and fee be postmarked?
sec04-card-sec04-R36.expected_back: A Record Review request must be in writing with the required fee, and both must be postmarked within twenty days of the notice date.

sec04-card-sec04-R37.front: How often can a Wyoming motorist receive a probationary limited-privilege license?
sec04-card-sec04-R37.expected_back: A driver can receive only one probationary license during a five-year period.

sec04-card-sec04-R38.front: What form, payment, and postmark deadline apply to requesting a Contested Case Hearing?
sec04-card-sec04-R38.expected_back: A Contested Case Hearing request must be written, include the required fee and be postmarked within twenty days of the notice date.

sec04-card-sec04-R39.front: How does revocation affect your driver license, and what is required before relicensing afterward?
sec04-card-sec04-R39.expected_back: Revocation cancels the driver license, and relicensing after revocation ends requires a driver investigation.

sec04-card-sec04-R40.front: Which repeat impaired-driving milestone appears on the handbook's revocation list?
sec04-card-sec04-R40.expected_back: A third or later DWUI is listed as a revocation-causing offense.

sec04-card-sec04-R41.front: Which repeat reckless-driving milestone triggers license revocation?
sec04-card-sec04-R41.expected_back: A third or later reckless-driving offense is listed as a cause of revocation.

sec04-card-sec04-R42.front: What crash-scene offense causes license revocation on the very first conviction?
sec04-card-sec04-R42.expected_back: Leaving an injury-crash scene is listed as a revocation-causing offense.

sec04-card-sec04-R43.front: How does a conviction for homicide by vehicle affect your Wyoming driver license?
sec04-card-sec04-R43.expected_back: Homicide by vehicle is listed as an offense causing revocation.

sec04-card-sec04-R44.front: How does a felony conviction tied directly to the manner of driving affect your license?
sec04-card-sec04-R44.expected_back: A felony directly resulting from the manner of driving is listed as a cause of revocation.

sec04-card-sec04-R45.front: What exactly is an SR-22, and who files it with WYDOT?
sec04-card-sec04-R45.expected_back: An SR-twenty-two is an insurance certificate that the insurer files with the department.

sec04-card-sec04-R46.front: How long must financial-responsibility proof remain on file for covered violations?
sec04-card-sec04-R46.expected_back: The financial-responsibility proof period stated for covered violations or actions is three years beginning when proof is required.

sec04-card-sec04-R47.front: What must an insurance company do if a policy backed by an SR-22 gets canceled?
sec04-card-sec04-R47.expected_back: When an SR-twenty-two is on file, the insurer must notify the department if the insurance is canceled.

sec04-card-sec04-R48.front: What happens when your mandatory suspension calendar ends if your required SR-22 is still missing?
sec04-card-sec04-R48.expected_back: If the required SR-twenty-two is missing when a mandatory suspension ends, driving privileges remain suspended until it is filed.

sec04-card-sec04-R49.front: How many days after WYDOT mails an order, or an officer serves it, does a suspension or revocation generally begin?
sec04-card-sec04-R49.expected_back: A suspension or revocation generally starts thirty days after the department mails the order or law enforcement gives it to the driver, or after existing suspensions end.

sec04-card-sec04-R50.front: Who pays the cost of installing a required ignition-interlock device?
sec04-card-sec04-R50.expected_back: Required ignition-interlock installation is at the applicant's expense.

sec04-card-sec04-R51.front: When does the interlock summary require six months of device use on a first DWUI or deferred prosecution?
sec04-card-sec04-R51.expected_back: The device summary requires six months of interlock for a first DWUI conviction or deferred prosecution when the administrative action shows BAC at least zero point one five percent.

sec04-card-sec04-R52.front: What interlock term does the device summary list after a second alcohol-involved DWUI conviction?
sec04-card-sec04-R52.expected_back: The device summary requires one year of interlock after a second DWUI conviction involving alcohol.

sec04-card-sec04-R53.front: How does the device summary state the interlock rule and removal window for a fourth or later alcohol DWUI?
sec04-card-sec04-R53.expected_back: The device summary gives a lifetime interlock requirement for a fourth or later alcohol-related DWUI conviction, with a possible removal petition five years after conviction.

sec04-card-sec04-R54.front: What insurance filing must accompany any alcohol-related conviction that requires ignition interlock?
sec04-card-sec04-R54.expected_back: A driver convicted of an alcohol-related offense requiring interlock must file an SR-twenty-two.

sec04-card-sec04-R55.front: Who must install ignition interlock, and which vehicles must carry the device?
sec04-card-sec04-R55.expected_back: A driver subject to the interlock-license installation requirements must use a department-certified technician at a certified installation site for every vehicle driven.

sec04-card-sec04-R57.front: Can you get an interlock-restricted license while suspended or revoked in any state for a separate non-DWUI reason?
sec04-card-sec04-R57.expected_back: An interlock-restricted license cannot be issued if driving privileges are suspended, revoked or canceled in any state for a reason other than the DWUI conviction creating the interlock requirement.

sec04-card-sec04-R58.front: What testing obligation applies when applying for an interlock-restricted license?
sec04-card-sec04-R58.expected_back: The interlock-license applicant must take and pass any required licensing tests.

sec04-card-sec04-R59.front: Can a driver simply sit out the calendar without driving to skip holding a required interlock-restricted license?
sec04-card-sec04-R59.expected_back: Another license type is unavailable until the driver has held the interlock-restricted license for the required period.

sec04-card-sec04-R60.front: What court-ordered program lets an eligible driver apply for a restricted license instead of ignition interlock?
sec04-card-sec04-R60.expected_back: A court order directing participation in the twenty-four over seven Sobriety Program instead of interlock allows the driver to apply for a twenty-four over seven restricted license.

sec05-card-sec05-F01.front: Who does Wyoming's general safety-belt rule cover inside a vehicle?
sec05-card-sec05-F01.expected_back: The handbook's general safety-belt rule covers every vehicle occupant, including the driver.

sec05-card-sec05-F02.front: Who holds legal responsibility for making sure riders follow the safety-belt law?
sec05-card-sec05-F02.expected_back: The driver is responsible for seeing that occupants comply with the safety-belt law.

sec05-card-sec05-F03.front: How must children be secured when riding in a vehicle?
sec05-card-sec05-F03.expected_back: Children must be secured properly in an appropriate child-restraint system.

sec05-card-sec05-F04.front: Where and how tightly should a lap belt rest across your lower body?
sec05-card-sec05-F04.expected_back: The lap belt should fit snugly over the hip bones.

sec05-card-sec05-F05.front: Over which part of the torso should a lap belt never rest?
sec05-card-sec05-F05.expected_back: The lap belt should never rest over the stomach or soft abdomen.

sec05-card-sec05-F06.front: How much freedom of movement should the driver's shoulder belt allow?
sec05-card-sec05-F06.expected_back: The shoulder belt should allow enough movement for the driver to reach important controls.

sec05-card-sec05-F07.front: Is it ever proper to wear the shoulder belt without the lap belt?
sec05-card-sec05-F07.expected_back: The shoulder belt should not be used by itself.

sec05-card-sec05-F08.front: Which age group of children is covered by Wyoming's child-restraint guide?
sec05-card-sec05-F08.expected_back: The child-restraint guide covers children who have not yet turned nine.

sec05-card-sec05-F09.front: Which drivers and passenger vehicles fall under the child-restraint guide?
sec05-card-sec05-F09.expected_back: The child-restraint guide applies to every driver operating a privately owned, leased or rented noncommercial passenger vehicle.

sec05-card-sec05-F10.front: Do Wyoming's child-restraint rules apply only to state residents or to visitors too?
sec05-card-sec05-F10.expected_back: The child-restraint requirements apply to residents and nonresidents alike.

sec05-card-sec05-F11.front: Where must a covered child sit, and what two situations allow using the front seat?
sec05-card-sec05-F11.expected_back: A child covered by the guide must use a seat other than the front, except in a single-row vehicle or when other child passengers are using all safety belts.

sec05-card-sec05-F12.front: Where must a rear-facing infant restraint never be positioned?
sec05-card-sec05-F12.expected_back: A rear-facing infant restraint must never be placed in front of an active airbag.

sec05-card-sec05-F13.front: What directions govern how a child is fastened inside a child restraint?
sec05-card-sec05-F13.expected_back: The child must be secured in the restraint according to the manufacturer's instructions.

sec05-card-sec05-F14.front: What rule governs how the child restraint itself is anchored into the vehicle?
sec05-card-sec05-F14.expected_back: The child restraint must also be installed according to the manufacturer's instructions.

sec05-card-sec05-F15.front: Which federal motor vehicle safety standard number must an approved child restraint meet?
sec05-card-sec05-F15.expected_back: A child restraint must meet Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard two hundred thirteen.

sec05-card-sec05-F16.front: How is child-restraint nonuse or misuse classified for a traffic stop?
sec05-card-sec05-F16.expected_back: Nonuse or misuse of a child restraint is a primary offense that provides reasonable suspicion to stop a vehicle and investigate a suspected violation.

sec05-card-sec05-F17.front: What is the maximum fine for a first child-restraint violation?
sec05-card-sec05-F17.expected_back: The maximum fine for a first child-restraint offense is sixty dollars.

sec05-card-sec05-F18.front: When must the court waive the fine on a first child-restraint offense?
sec05-card-sec05-F18.expected_back: The court must waive the first-offense fine when it receives proof that an approved restraint was purchased, leased or otherwise acquired after the offense.

sec05-card-sec05-F19.front: What is the maximum fine for a second or later child-restraint offense?
sec05-card-sec05-F19.expected_back: The maximum fine for a second or later child-restraint offense is one hundred ten dollars.

sec05-card-sec05-F20.front: When is a child under nine exempt from needing a separate child restraint based on belt fit?
sec05-card-sec05-F20.expected_back: A child within the covered age range is exempt from a separate child restraint when the lap and shoulder belt fits the collarbone, chest and hips properly without endangering the neck, face or abdomen during a crash or sudden stop.

sec05-card-sec05-F21.front: What paperwork is required in the vehicle for a medical exemption from a child restraint?
sec05-card-sec05-F21.expected_back: The medical child-restraint exemption requires a signed physician statement kept in the car saying that the child should not use a child-restraint system.

sec05-card-sec05-F22.front: How do child-restraint rules treat a vehicle built at the factory without safety belts?
sec05-card-sec05-F22.expected_back: A vehicle not equipped with safety belts when manufactured is exempt from the child-restraint requirements.

sec05-card-sec05-F23.front: Which model years mark the factory-beltless exemption for passenger cars versus vans and trucks?
sec05-card-sec05-F23.expected_back: The guide identifies passenger vehicles before model year nineteen sixty-seven and vans or trucks before model year nineteen seventy-two in its exemption for vehicles manufactured without safety belts.

sec05-card-sec05-F24.front: How do child-restraint requirements apply to emergency and law-enforcement vehicles?
sec05-card-sec05-F24.expected_back: Emergency vehicles and law-enforcement vehicles are exempt from the child-restraint requirements.

sec05-card-sec05-F25.front: Which buses carrying children are included on the child-restraint exemption list?
sec05-card-sec05-F25.expected_back: The child-restraint exemption list includes school buses, including private or church buses, when used to transport children.

sec05-card-sec05-F26.front: When are public-transportation buses or other transit vehicles exempt from child-restraint rules?
sec05-card-sec05-F26.expected_back: The exemption list also includes public-transportation buses or other public-transportation vehicles manufactured without seat belts.

sec05-card-sec05-F27.front: How does the child-restraint law treat a driver giving emergency aid or assistance to a child or parent?
sec05-card-sec05-F27.expected_back: The child-restraint exemption list covers a driver rendering aid or assistance to the child, parent or guardian.

sec05-card-sec05-R01.front: Above what weight does handbook booster guidance start, and what else must you check?
sec05-card-sec05-R01.expected_back: The handbook's belt-positioning booster guidance describes protection for a child over forty pounds and directs the reader to the booster's individual height and weight limits.

sec05-card-sec05-R02.front: Which booster style fits a seat with a headrest, and where should that headrest sit?
sec05-card-sec05-R02.expected_back: When a vehicle headrest is available, the booster guidance recommends a low-back belt-positioning booster with the headrest adjusted behind the ears at the middle of the child's head.

sec05-card-sec05-R03.front: Which booster type does the handbook recommend when the vehicle seat has no headrest?
sec05-card-sec05-R03.expected_back: Without a vehicle headrest, the guide recommends a high-back belt-positioning booster to protect the child's head.

sec05-card-sec05-R04.front: Which belt type works with a belt-positioning booster, and what if a seat only has a lap belt?
sec05-card-sec05-R04.expected_back: The guide supports booster use with a lap-and-shoulder belt, while a lap-only belt requires consideration of other options.

sec05-card-sec05-R05.front: Where must a child's back and buttocks stay for a vehicle seat belt to fit properly?
sec05-card-sec05-R05.expected_back: For a seat belt to fit, the child's back and buttocks must remain against the vehicle seat back.

sec05-card-sec05-R06.front: Where must both the shoulder strap and lap strap sit for proper seat-belt fit on a child?
sec05-card-sec05-R06.expected_back: For proper belt fit, the shoulder belt must stay on the shoulder and snug across the chest while the lap belt sits low over the hip or upper thigh.

sec05-card-sec05-R07.front: How must a child's knees line up with the vehicle seat cushion to pass the belt-fit check?
sec05-card-sec05-R07.expected_back: A child meeting the seat-belt fit criteria must be able to bend the knees fully over the vehicle-seat edge.

sec05-card-sec05-R08.front: Where must a child's feet rest, and how long must they maintain that belt-fit posture?
sec05-card-sec05-R08.expected_back: The seat-belt fit criteria require feet flat on the floor and the ability to remain comfortably in that position for the whole trip.

sec05-card-sec05-R09.front: When is a vehicle occupant medically exempt from wearing a safety belt?
sec05-card-sec05-R09.expected_back: A person with a physician's written statement that a belt is inadvisable for physical or medical reasons is exempt from belt use.

sec05-card-sec05-R10.front: How does the belt law apply in a passenger vehicle that federal rules did not require to have belts?
sec05-card-sec05-R10.expected_back: A person in a passenger vehicle that federal law does not require to have safety belts is exempt from wearing one.

sec05-card-sec05-R11.front: When is a United States Postal Service worker exempt from the safety-belt requirement?
sec05-card-sec05-R11.expected_back: A United States Postal Service worker performing postal-carrier duties is exempt from the belt requirement.

sec05-card-sec05-R12.front: Does someone properly strapped into a child safety-restraint system also need a separate adult belt?
sec05-card-sec05-R12.expected_back: A person properly secured in a child safety-restraint system need not separately wear a safety belt.

sec05-card-sec05-R13.front: When is a front-seat occupant exempt from wearing a safety belt due to seating capacity?
sec05-card-sec05-R13.expected_back: A front-seat occupant is exempt from belt use when the driver or passengers are already using all operable safety restraints in the vehicle.

sec06-card-sec06-F01.front: How does the Wyoming handbook describe the Driver License Compact?
sec06-card-sec06-F01.expected_back: The Driver License Compact is described as a framework for cooperation among states on licensing issues.

sec06-card-sec06-F02.front: What two-part concept anchors the handbook's Driver License Compact discussion?
sec06-card-sec06-F02.expected_back: The compact discussion uses the concept of one driver license and one driving record.
