sec14-card-sec14-R17.expected_back: When glare recovery is slow, looking toward the road's right side away from the glare can help.

sec14-card-sec14-R18.front: What does the handbook name as the single best solution for poor headlight glare recovery?
sec14-card-sec14-R18.expected_back: For poor glare recovery, the handbook identifies daylight-only driving as the best solution.

sec14-card-sec14-R19.front: Which roadway sounds can warn you to adjust speed or lane position before your eyes spot trouble?
sec14-card-sec14-R19.expected_back: Screeching tires, trains, sirens, horns or a motor in a blind spot can be auditory cues for changing speed or direction.

sec14-card-sec14-R20.front: Which two equipment aids does the handbook list to help drivers compensate for hearing loss?
sec14-card-sec14-R20.expected_back: The handbook lists hearing aids and outside mirrors as ways to compensate for hearing loss.

sec14-card-sec14-R21.front: What scanning habits help drivers with reduced hearing stay safe in traffic?
sec14-card-sec14-R21.expected_back: Extra alertness, broader side scanning and side mirrors can help compensate for poor hearing.

sec14-card-sec14-R22.front: What two interior factors can cause even a driver with sharp hearing to miss sirens or horns?
sec14-card-sec14-R22.expected_back: Even normal hearing may miss important road sounds when vehicle soundproofing or loud audio masks them.

sec14-card-sec14-R23.front: How should you set music or podcast volume inside your vehicle?
sec14-card-sec14-R23.expected_back: Keep interior sound volume low enough to hear important traffic cues.

sec14-card-sec14-R24.front: How does operating a cell phone behind the wheel affect vehicle control?
sec14-card-sec14-R24.expected_back: Using a cell phone while driving can distract from safe vehicle operation.

sec14-card-sec14-R25.front: Does switching a phone call to hands-free eliminate the distraction of talking while driving?
sec14-card-sec14-R25.expected_back: Conversation itself can be a major driving distraction, including during hands-free calls.

sec14-card-sec14-R26.front: What does Wyoming law prohibit regarding electronic text messages while operating a vehicle?
sec14-card-sec14-R26.expected_back: The handbook's Wyoming-law summary prohibits reading or sending text on a phone or other device while operating a vehicle.

sec14-card-sec14-R27.front: Why must you watch posted city-limit signs regarding cell phone calls across Wyoming?
sec14-card-sec14-R27.expected_back: Some Wyoming communities prohibit calls while operating a vehicle within city limits, so check local restrictions and posted notices.

sec14-card-sec14-R28.front: What does the Wyoming Department of Transportation advise doing before making a call or sending a text?
sec14-card-sec14-R28.expected_back: WYDOT recommends pulling well off the highway and stopping before calling or texting.

sec14-card-sec14-R29.front: How should you handle a phone call that turns long, emotional, or mentally demanding?
sec14-card-sec14-R29.expected_back: Avoid long, emotional or otherwise distracting calls and arrange to call back when safe.

sec14-card-sec14-R30.front: Why should you evaluate your fitness before every drive rather than assuming yesterday's readiness?
sec14-card-sec14-R30.expected_back: Decide to drive only when fully able, recognizing that physical, mental and emotional conditions can change daily.

sec14-card-sec14-R31.front: Who can help you judge whether an illness, medication, or disability compromises safe driving?
sec14-card-sec14-R31.expected_back: A doctor's advice can help assess whether an illness or disability affects safe driving.

sec01-card-sec01-F01.question_text: Which four credential types make operating a motor vehicle on Wyoming roads lawful?
sec01-card-sec01-F01.teaching_text: Driving without holding an active full license, learner permit, intermediate card, or restricted credential violates Wyoming law.

sec01-card-sec01-F02.question_text: Which program and agency issue driver licenses in Wyoming?
sec01-card-sec01-F02.teaching_text: Know that Driver Services inside the Wyoming Department of Transportation handles statewide licensing rather than county clerks.

sec01-card-sec01-F03.question_text: When may federal employees drive in Wyoming without obtaining a Wyoming driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F03.teaching_text: This narrow exemption covers official United States government vehicles only, not personal errands in a private car.

sec01-card-sec01-F04.question_text: What licensing exemption covers active-duty military personnel stationed in Wyoming along with their dependents?
sec01-card-sec01-F04.teaching_text: Stationed service members and dependents can keep driving on an unexpired home-state credential throughout their Wyoming tour.

sec01-card-sec01-F05.question_text: When are full-time college or university students in Wyoming excused from getting a Wyoming driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F05.teaching_text: Full-time college enrollment lets nonresident students drive legally in Wyoming as long as their home license stays valid.

sec01-card-sec01-F06.question_text: Within what period of establishing Wyoming residency must a driver from another Driver License Compact state surrender that license?
sec01-card-sec01-F06.teaching_text: Watch out for shorter deadlines in other states because Wyoming's manual sets a one-year surrender mark for Compact licenses.

sec01-card-sec01-F07.question_text: Can someone obtain a Wyoming license while suspended, canceled, denied, or revoked in another state?
sec01-card-sec01-F07.teaching_text: National driver registries flag active suspensions, cancellations, denials, or revocations nationwide, blocking a new Wyoming card.

sec01-card-sec01-F08.question_text: What happens to your license application if you fail any mandatory part of the driver examination?
sec01-card-sec01-F08.teaching_text: Vision, written knowledge, and road skills must each be passed before WYDOT can issue a driver license.

sec01-card-sec01-F09.question_text: How does a court determination of legal incompetence affect Wyoming driver-license eligibility?
sec01-card-sec01-F09.teaching_text: Safe highway judgment requires legal competence, placing adjudicated incompetence directly on Wyoming's statutory ineligibility list.

sec01-card-sec01-F10.question_text: Under what age does the manual's general ineligibility list bar a standard driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F10.teaching_text: Apart from special learner or hardship permits, ordinary Wyoming driver-license eligibility begins at sixteen.

sec01-card-sec01-F11.question_text: How does habitual use of alcohol affect eligibility for a Wyoming driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F11.teaching_text: Chronic alcohol dependence creates persistent highway crash risk and disqualifies an applicant under Wyoming's eligibility rules.

sec01-card-sec01-F12.question_text: How does violating federal immigration laws affect an application for a Wyoming driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F12.teaching_text: Applicants must establish lawful status because violating United States immigration laws is an explicit licensing barrier.

sec01-card-sec01-F13.question_text: Does a standard noncommercial Class C Wyoming license authorize you to ride a motorcycle?
sec01-card-sec01-F13.teaching_text: Two-wheel motorcycles demand separate balance and braking skills not covered by an ordinary Class C car license.

sec01-card-sec01-F14.question_text: Below what Gross Vehicle Weight Rating must a single vehicle or combination stay under a noncommercial Class C license?
sec01-card-sec01-F14.teaching_text: Reaching 26,001 pounds crosses into commercial weight territory, so Class C caps single or combined ratings at 26,000.

sec01-card-sec01-F33.question_text: Under the noncommercial Class C towing rule, what is the maximum GVWR allowed for the towed unit?
sec01-card-sec01-F33.teaching_text: Keep both Class C caps paired on test day, staying below 26,001 pounds overall with a trailer at or under 10,000.

sec01-card-sec01-F15.question_text: Which two fundamental categories of proof must an applicant present to get a Wyoming license?
sec01-card-sec01-F15.teaching_text: Every counter visit starts by proving both who you legally are and where you actually live in Wyoming.

sec01-card-sec01-F16.question_text: Which three examinations make up Wyoming's standard driver-licensing test trio?
sec01-card-sec01-F16.teaching_text: Checking road-rule knowledge, eyesight, and behind-the-wheel control ensures new drivers handle Wyoming highways safely.

sec01-card-sec01-F17.question_text: What extra signed authorization is required from a parent or legal guardian when an applicant is under eighteen?
sec01-card-sec01-F17.teaching_text: Minors under 18 cannot receive a Wyoming permit or license without a legal parent or guardian signing the release.

sec01-card-sec01-F18.question_text: At what age does Wyoming's standard instruction permit become available?
sec01-card-sec01-F18.teaching_text: Turning 15 opens the standard supervised learner pathway unless an earlier rural hardship exception applies.

sec01-card-sec01-F19.question_text: At what age do limited solo driving privileges become available under a Wyoming intermediate license?
sec01-card-sec01-F19.teaching_text: Age 16 unlocks solo driving with passenger, seat-belt, and night-curfew safeguards under an intermediate card.

sec01-card-sec01-F20.question_text: Which three primary documents can establish legal identification for a first-time Wyoming license or ID applicant?
sec01-card-sec01-F20.teaching_text: Hospital souvenir birth certificates get rejected at the counter, so bring a state-certified copy, valid US passport, or immigration docs.

sec01-card-sec01-F21.question_text: What extra documentation is required if your current last name does not match your primary identity document?
sec01-card-sec01-F21.teaching_text: Examiners must trace an unbroken legal paper trail linking your birth or passport surname to your current name.

sec01-card-sec01-F22.question_text: Which three official records can prove a legal name change at the licensing counter?
sec01-card-sec01-F22.teaching_text: Bringing a certified marriage record, divorce decree, or court name-change order prevents a wasted trip to Driver Services.

sec01-card-sec01-F23.question_text: Which documents are accepted to verify an applicant's Social Security number?
sec01-card-sec01-F23.teaching_text: Any W-2 wage form or financial or bank statement you use instead of the card must display your Social Security number.

sec01-card-sec01-F24.question_text: How soon and in what form must a Wyoming license holder report a change of address?
sec01-card-sec01-F24.teaching_text: Missing Wyoming's strict 10-day written notice deadline can cause you to miss renewal mailings or suspension notices.

sec01-card-sec01-F25.question_text: How many residency documents are required in Wyoming, and why won't a PO Box qualify?
sec01-card-sec01-F25.teaching_text: WYDOT requires two separate proofs showing a physical Wyoming street residence rather than a post-office box.

sec01-card-sec01-F26.question_text: When can a vehicle title or registration count toward proving Wyoming residency?
sec01-card-sec01-F26.teaching_text: A Wyoming title or registration qualifies as one of your two residency proofs only if it prints your residential address.

sec01-card-sec01-F27.question_text: Which four housing-related documents can establish Wyoming residency when they show your physical address?
sec01-card-sec01-F27.teaching_text: Renters and homeowners alike can satisfy residency verification using lease agreements, rental receipts, mortgages, or property-tax bills.

sec01-card-sec01-F28.question_text: Can federal tax paperwork count as one of your Wyoming residency proofs?
sec01-card-sec01-F28.teaching_text: Federal tax filings bearing your physical Wyoming street address qualify toward the two-document residency requirement.

sec01-card-sec01-F29.question_text: When do statements from a Wyoming bank or credit union qualify as residency evidence?
sec01-card-sec01-F29.teaching_text: Make sure your Wyoming bank or credit-union statement prints your street residence rather than a mailing box.

sec01-card-sec01-F30.question_text: Beyond the specific examples, what broader category of paperwork may Driver Services accept for residency?
sec01-card-sec01-F30.teaching_text: Examiners can accept additional official legal records whenever they clearly tie you to a Wyoming residential address.

sec01-card-sec01-F31.question_text: What two-eye visual acuity score is required to pass Wyoming's standard vision screening?
sec01-card-sec01-F31.teaching_text: Applicants can meet the 20-over-40 standard either naturally or while wearing corrective glasses or contacts.

sec01-card-sec01-F32.question_text: At least how many degrees of combined horizontal visual field does Wyoming require?
sec01-card-sec01-F32.teaching_text: Wide 120-degree side vision lets you spot cross-traffic cars, cyclists, and wildlife entering from roadway edges.

sec01-card-sec01-R01.question_text: What vehicle limitation does Restriction A place on a Wyoming driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-R01.teaching_text: Link letter A straight to Automatic so you never confuse transmission limits with corrective lenses.

sec01-card-sec01-R02.question_text: What does Restriction B require whenever the license holder is behind the wheel?
sec01-card-sec01-R02.teaching_text: If you wear glasses or contacts to pass the counter eye chart, code B makes wearing them mandatory on the road.

sec01-card-sec01-R03.question_text: What driving equipment does Restriction C indicate on a Wyoming license?
sec01-card-sec01-R03.teaching_text: Code C covers vehicle-mounted mechanical adaptations such as hand controls or steering knobs.

sec01-card-sec01-R04.question_text: What personal assistive device does Restriction D signify on a Wyoming license?
sec01-card-sec01-R04.teaching_text: Keep C and D distinct on test day, with C for car mechanical aids and D for personal prosthetic devices.

sec01-card-sec01-R05.question_text: To what hours does Restriction G confine a Wyoming motorist's driving?
sec01-card-sec01-R05.teaching_text: Drivers whose night vision falls short of nighttime standards often receive code G restricting travel to daylight hours.

sec01-card-sec01-R06.question_text: How does the Wyoming manual define Restriction I on a driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-R06.teaching_text: Code I acts as WYDOT's flexible catch-all limitation for tailored medical or operational conditions.

sec01-card-sec01-R07.question_text: What special credential status does Restriction J mark on a Wyoming license?
sec01-card-sec01-R07.teaching_text: Code J validates temporary or out-of-area credentials issued legitimately without an in-person photo or signature.

sec01-card-sec01-R08.question_text: To what specific vehicle type does Restriction R limit operation?
sec01-card-sec01-R08.teaching_text: Match letter R directly to Recreational four-wheel vehicles so you never confuse it with rural teenage permits.

sec01-card-sec01-R09.question_text: What step must an applicant take after failing the counter vision screening?
sec01-card-sec01-R09.teaching_text: An optometrist or ophthalmologist evaluates whether new lenses or daylight restrictions allow safe licensing.

sec01-card-sec01-R10.question_text: If you use eyeglasses or contacts to pass WYDOT's eye check, what rule follows on the road?
sec01-card-sec01-R10.teaching_text: Driving bare-eyed when your license carries a corrective-lens requirement counts as a moving restriction violation.

sec01-card-sec01-R11.question_text: Within what visual-acuity range worse than 20 over 40 must an applicant pass a driving-skills test?
sec01-card-sec01-R11.teaching_text: Applicants seeing worse than 20 over 40 yet at least 20 over 100 must prove safe real-world compensation on a road test.

sec01-card-sec01-R12.question_text: Where do all questions on Wyoming's written knowledge exam come from?
sec01-card-sec01-R12.teaching_text: Every multiple-choice item is grounded straight inside the official WYDOT manual rather than trick trivia.

sec01-card-sec01-R13.question_text: Which three visual features must you recognize to identify traffic signs on the written exam?
sec01-card-sec01-R13.teaching_text: Snow, glare, or distance can obscure words, so recognizing octagons, pentagons, colors, and pictograms is essential.

sec01-card-sec01-R14.question_text: Alongside road signs, which two roadway control systems are tested on the written knowledge exam?
sec01-card-sec01-R14.teaching_text: Knowing overhead signal arrows and yellow-versus-white lane lines prevents wrong-way and intersection errors.

sec01-card-sec01-R15.question_text: Which four core subject areas do Wyoming's written multiple-choice questions cover?
sec01-card-sec01-R15.teaching_text: Studying statutes alone isn't enough when test items also probe defensive crash avoidance and required vehicle equipment.

sec01-card-sec01-R16.question_text: At most how many times may an applicant take the written knowledge exam in a single day?
sec01-card-sec01-R16.teaching_text: If you miss on a second attempt the same day, you must stop, study the manual, and return another day.

sec01-card-sec01-R17.question_text: In what language are Wyoming tests given, and what option exists for applicants who cannot speak or write English?
sec01-card-sec01-R17.teaching_text: While exam materials are English-only, eligible non-English speakers may use an interpreter under station rules.

sec01-card-sec01-R18.question_text: When must an applicant ask if they need an oral version of the knowledge test?
sec01-card-sec01-R18.teaching_text: Alerting the exam counter ahead of time lets staff arrange an oral session before starting your attempt.

sec01-card-sec01-R19.question_text: What behind-the-wheel requirement applies to a first-time applicant never licensed in any state?
sec01-card-sec01-R19.teaching_text: Unless waived through qualifying driver education, brand-new drivers must demonstrate real-world vehicle control.

sec01-card-sec01-R20.question_text: Will a Wyoming examiner ever ask you to perform an illegal traffic move during a skills test?
sec01-card-sec01-R20.teaching_text: Examiners test lawful everyday driving only and never try to trick you into parking by a hydrant or running red.

sec01-card-sec01-R21.question_text: Can WYDOT require a driving test in situations beyond brand-new first-time licensing?
sec01-card-sec01-R21.teaching_text: Vision changes, medical referrals, or expired credentials can prompt an examiner to verify safe behind-the-wheel ability.

sec01-card-sec01-R22.question_text: How long must you wait to retake the driving-skills exam after failing an attempt?
sec01-card-sec01-R22.teaching_text: Contrast the written test's twice-a-day allowance with the mandatory 24-hour cooldown after a failed road test.

sec01-card-sec01-R23.question_text: What document from an approved driver-education course can waive the WYDOT driving-skills exam?
sec01-card-sec01-R23.teaching_text: Presenting a valid completion card from an approved program can excuse you from taking a separate station road test.

sec01-card-sec01-R24.question_text: Which three student identifiers must appear on a driver-education completion certification card?
sec01-card-sec01-R24.teaching_text: Examiners check that your full name, date of birth, and learner-permit number match your WYDOT record.

sec01-card-sec01-R25.question_text: Whose two original signatures must appear on a valid driver-education certification card?
sec01-card-sec01-R25.teaching_text: Photocopied or stamped signatures fail counter verification because both the instructor and administrator must sign in ink.

sec01-card-sec01-R26.question_text: How many classroom hours and behind-the-wheel hours must a driver-education card confirm?
sec01-card-sec01-R26.teaching_text: Memorize the 30-hour classroom plus 6-hour behind-the-wheel split required on Wyoming driver-ed certificates.

sec01-card-sec01-R27.question_text: For how long is a Wyoming driver-education completion certification card honored?
sec01-card-sec01-R27.teaching_text: Waiting past two years invalidates the skills-test waiver, forcing you to pass a live road exam.

sec02-card-sec02-F01.question_text: Which three tests must first-time Wyoming license applicants pass when no skills waiver applies?
sec02-card-sec02-F01.teaching_text: Every first-time licensee clears written rules and vision checks, plus a behind-the-wheel test unless formally waived.

sec02-card-sec02-F02.question_text: Which two credentials can excuse a first-time Wyoming applicant from taking the driving-skills exam?
sec02-card-sec02-F02.teaching_text: Either transferring an unexpired license from another state or presenting an approved driver-ed certificate can waive the road test.

sec02-card-sec02-F03.question_text: What signed form must accompany a first-license application when the applicant is under eighteen?
sec02-card-sec02-F03.teaching_text: A legal parent or guardian must sign the minor's release before WYDOT issues any under-18 license.

sec02-card-sec02-F04.question_text: Which two screenings should you arrive ready to pass when applying for an instruction permit?
sec02-card-sec02-F04.teaching_text: You must prove you know road signs and rules and see clearly before practicing behind the wheel.

sec02-card-sec02-F05.question_text: Who must sit in the front passenger seat alongside an instruction-permit driver?
sec02-card-sec02-F05.teaching_text: Unlike states requiring a 21-year-old coach, Wyoming sets the front-seat supervisor minimum at 18 holding that vehicle class.

sec02-card-sec02-F06.question_text: Who qualifies for a standard Wyoming driver-license renewal?
sec02-card-sec02-F06.teaching_text: Keeping your current Wyoming credential active lets you renew smoothly instead of starting over as expired.

sec02-card-sec02-F07.question_text: How early before expiration may a license holder over twenty-one renew?
sec02-card-sec02-F07.teaching_text: Adult drivers over 21 enjoy a full four-month 120-day early-renewal window ahead of expiration.

sec02-card-sec02-F08.question_text: Within what pre-expiration window may a license holder under twenty-one renew according to the manual?
sec02-card-sec02-F08.teaching_text: Keep the 120-day over-21 window distinct from the 90-day renewal window listed for drivers under 21.

sec02-card-sec02-F09.question_text: How close to turning twenty-one must an under-21 holder wait to renew into an adult-style horizontal license?
sec02-card-sec02-F09.teaching_text: Renewing earlier than 30 days before your 21st birthday leaves you with an under-21 format card.

sec02-card-sec02-F10.question_text: Which screening is mandatory at renewal, and what extra test may an examiner require?
sec02-card-sec02-F10.teaching_text: Every in-person renewal checks your eyesight, and examiners retain discretion to require a driving-skills check.

sec02-card-sec02-F11.question_text: How often may a current Wyoming driver license be renewed by mail?
sec02-card-sec02-F11.teaching_text: Mail renewal works every other cycle so WYDOT updates your photo and vision in person on alternating renewals.

sec02-card-sec02-F12.question_text: What happens if you let your Wyoming driver license expire before renewing?
sec02-card-sec02-F12.teaching_text: Once expired, mail renewal vanishes and you must visit a station in person where all exam phases may apply.

sec02-card-sec02-F31.question_text: How many days before expiration does WYDOT mail renewal packets to drivers over 21 versus under 21?
sec02-card-sec02-F31.teaching_text: Mailout timing mirrors each group's renewal window, arriving 120 days ahead for adults and 90 days ahead under 21.

sec02-card-sec02-F32.question_text: To which address does WYDOT send renewal-by-mail packets?
sec02-card-sec02-F32.teaching_text: Failing to report a move within 10 days sends your renewal packet to an outdated address.

sec02-card-sec02-F13.question_text: At what age can a Wyoming teen earn full driving privileges even without holding a prior permit or license?
sec02-card-sec02-F13.teaching_text: Waiting until 17 bypasses prior permit holding periods if you pass every required licensing exam.

sec02-card-sec02-F14.question_text: Can a seventeen-year-old upgrade to a full license while restricted driving privileges are suspended?
sec02-card-sec02-F14.teaching_text: Turning 17 never erases an active restricted suspension; all suspensions must clear before full privileges issue.

sec02-card-sec02-F15.question_text: What core verification document requirement applies to a seventeen-year-old applying for full privileges?
sec02-card-sec02-F15.teaching_text: First-time full-license applicants at 17 still bring primary legal identity proof to the exam counter.

sec02-card-sec02-F16.question_text: Which three tests must an applicant pass to gain full Wyoming driving privileges directly at age seventeen?
sec02-card-sec02-F16.teaching_text: Skipping earlier graduated stages at 17 still requires passing the eye screen, written rules test, and road exam.

sec02-card-sec02-F17.question_text: What three conditions allow a teen to earn full Wyoming driving privileges early at age sixteen and a half?
sec02-card-sec02-F17.teaching_text: Completing approved driver ed plus holding a suspension-free intermediate license for six months shaves six months off full licensing.

sec02-card-sec02-F18.question_text: What kind of driver-education certificate qualifies a teen for the sixteen-and-a-half full-license route?
sec02-card-sec02-F18.teaching_text: Online-only theory courses fall short because Wyoming requires Department of Education approval including behind-the-wheel instruction.

sec02-card-sec02-F19.question_text: Which two counter checks must the sixteen-and-a-half full-license applicant complete?
sec02-card-sec02-F19.teaching_text: Even when upgrading an intermediate card at 16 and a half, bring identity proof and clear the eye screening.

sec02-card-sec02-F20.question_text: What parental signature and payment complete the sixteen-and-a-half full-license application?
sec02-card-sec02-F20.teaching_text: Because a 16-and-a-half applicant is still a minor, a parent or guardian signs the Minor's Release alongside the fee.

sec02-card-sec02-F21.question_text: At what ages and under what family circumstance may Wyoming issue a restricted hardship license?
sec02-card-sec02-F21.teaching_text: Wyoming's rural hardship license helps 14- and 15-year-olds only when the household faces documented extreme inconvenience.

sec02-card-sec02-F22.question_text: What prior permit and minimum commute distance are required to qualify for a restricted license?
sec02-card-sec02-F22.teaching_text: Rural teens qualify only when they hold a learner permit and reside five-plus miles away from work or classes.

sec02-card-sec02-F23.question_text: Which agency investigates and approves restricted-license hardship applications in Wyoming?
sec02-card-sec02-F23.teaching_text: Remember that the Wyoming Highway Patrol, not local school principals, reviews and approves hardship applications.

sec02-card-sec02-F24.question_text: Between what daily clock hours may a 14- or 15-year-old restricted-license holder drive?
sec02-card-sec02-F24.teaching_text: Keep the 5 AM-to-8 PM restricted window distinct from the 11 PM-to-5 AM intermediate curfew.

sec02-card-sec02-F25.question_text: How far from home may a restricted-license holder legally drive?
sec02-card-sec02-F25.teaching_text: Vast Wyoming county distances set the restricted boundary at a 50-mile radius around the holder's residence.

sec02-card-sec02-F26.question_text: How many moving-traffic convictions does it take to suspend a 14- or 15-year-old's restricted license?
sec02-card-sec02-F26.teaching_text: Restricted teen drivers get zero mulligans because even one moving traffic conviction suspends the credential.

sec02-card-sec02-F27.question_text: What happens if a restricted-license holder drives past 8 PM, before 5 AM, or beyond 50 miles from home?
sec02-card-sec02-F27.teaching_text: Stepping outside either the 5 AM-to-8 PM window or the 50-mile home circle triggers license suspension.

sec02-card-sec02-F28.question_text: When does a restricted hardship license automatically expire?
sec02-card-sec02-F28.teaching_text: Once you turn 16, you have 30 days to upgrade before the hardship restricted card expires.

sec02-card-sec02-F29.question_text: Who can get a restricted instruction permit at age fourteen or fifteen?
sec02-card-sec02-F29.teaching_text: Once Highway Patrol approves hardship need, teens aged 14 or 15 without a permit receive a restricted learner permit.

sec02-card-sec02-F30.question_text: How long is a Wyoming restricted instruction permit valid?
sec02-card-sec02-F30.teaching_text: That 60-day window gives approved hardship teens two months of supervised practice to prepare for restricted licensing.

sec02-card-sec02-R01.question_text: At what minimum age can a teen receive a Wyoming intermediate driver license?
sec02-card-sec02-R01.teaching_text: Reaching your 16th birthday opens Wyoming's intermediate stage between supervised permits and full adult driving.

sec02-card-sec02-R02.question_text: How can holding a Restricted Class C license help a sixteen-year-old qualify for an intermediate license?
sec02-card-sec02-R02.teaching_text: Graduating from a Restricted Class C card serves as an alternate qualifying path alongside standard instruction-permit hours.

sec02-card-sec02-R03.question_text: How many total and nighttime driving hours must a parent or guardian certify on the instruction-permit path to an intermediate license?
sec02-card-sec02-R03.teaching_text: Lock in 50 logged practice hours including 10 after dark, signed off by your parent or legal guardian.

sec02-card-sec02-R04.question_text: Which two basic counter requirements must every intermediate-license applicant satisfy?
sec02-card-sec02-R04.teaching_text: Bring acceptable identity documents and corrective lenses if needed to clear the counter vision screen.

sec02-card-sec02-R05.question_text: When may an intermediate-license applicant skip the WYDOT driving-skills test?
sec02-card-sec02-R05.teaching_text: Without an approved driver-education completion card, every intermediate applicant must pass the behind-the-wheel exam.

sec02-card-sec02-R06.question_text: What payment and signed parental document are required to issue an intermediate license?
sec02-card-sec02-R06.teaching_text: Bring both the licensing fee and a parent- or guardian-signed minor's release to finish intermediate issuance.

sec02-card-sec02-R07.question_text: How many non-family passengers under eighteen may ride with an unsupervised intermediate-license driver?
sec02-card-sec02-R07.teaching_text: Peer distraction spikes teen crash rates, so carrying more than one non-family minor requires an 18-plus licensed adult aboard.

sec02-card-sec02-R08.question_text: Who must wear a seat belt inside a vehicle driven by an intermediate-license holder?
sec02-card-sec02-R08.teaching_text: The intermediate driver is legally responsible for making sure every passenger in every seat clicks a belt.

sec02-card-sec02-R09.question_text: Between what overnight hours is an intermediate driver barred from driving without a signed exception form?
sec02-card-sec02-R09.teaching_text: Late-night fatigue and low visibility peak between 11 PM and 5 AM unless a documented exception applies.

sec02-card-sec02-R10.question_text: Who must certify a medical necessity to qualify an intermediate driver for overnight driving?
sec02-card-sec02-R10.teaching_text: Scheduled overnight medical care qualifies between 11 PM and 5 AM when certified by medical personnel.

sec02-card-sec02-R11.question_text: How does a job commute between 11 PM and 5 AM qualify under the intermediate night restriction?
sec02-card-sec02-R11.teaching_text: Driving directly to or from work after 11 PM is lawful once your employer signs the exception form.

sec02-card-sec02-R12.question_text: Which four youth activities qualify for an overnight exception when certified by a parent or guardian?
sec02-card-sec02-R12.teaching_text: Late tournament buses, school events, organized sports, or faith youth groups qualify with parental certification.

sec02-card-sec02-R13.question_text: How can an unexpected medical emergency qualify under the intermediate night-driving rule?
sec02-card-sec02-R13.teaching_text: Urgent overnight emergencies qualify when supported by evidence from treating medical personnel.

sec02-card-sec02-R14.question_text: Who must fill out and sign the intermediate driver's overnight exception form?
sec02-card-sec02-R14.teaching_text: Parents sign school or sports forms, employers sign work forms, and medical staff verify medical trips.

sec02-card-sec02-R15.question_text: Where must the signed overnight exception form be kept while an intermediate driver travels after 11 PM?
sec02-card-sec02-R15.teaching_text: Leaving your signed exception form on the kitchen counter won't help during a midnight traffic stop.

sec02-card-sec02-R16.question_text: What suspension length follows violating intermediate passenger, belt, or curfew rules?
sec02-card-sec02-R16.teaching_text: Breaking the passenger cap, unbuckled belt rule, or 11 PM curfew triggers a mandatory 30-day license suspension.

sec03-card-sec03-F01.question_text: When does a Wyoming intermediate license automatically expire?
sec03-card-sec03-F01.teaching_text: Compare the two teen expirations carefully so you pair restricted cards with 16 and intermediate cards with 30 days past 17.

sec03-card-sec03-F02.question_text: What clinician document may Driver Services require before licensing an applicant with a disability?
sec03-card-sec03-F02.teaching_text: Reviewing a doctor's medical or vision report helps examiners verify safe vehicle control and appropriate adaptive gear.

sec03-card-sec03-F03.question_text: How must WYDOT handle license restrictions recommended for safe driving by an applicant's doctor or eye specialist?
sec03-card-sec03-F03.teaching_text: Following recommendations from a physician, optometrist, or ophthalmologist lets drivers stay mobile within safe limits.

sec03-card-sec03-F04.question_text: Besides medical paperwork, what in-person evaluation can add safety restrictions for an applicant with a disability?
sec03-card-sec03-F04.teaching_text: Observing behind-the-wheel control directly shows whether hand controls, mirrors, or daylight limits support safe driving.

sec03-card-sec03-F05.question_text: Which Wyoming agency coordinates police, Weather Service, broadcasters, and WYDOT during an Amber Alert?
sec03-card-sec03-F05.teaching_text: Wyoming DCI acts as the central statewide hub linking local police reports to highway signs and broadcast airwaves.

sec03-card-sec03-F06.question_text: How many of the listed activation criteria must be met before an Amber Alert can go out?
sec03-card-sec03-F06.teaching_text: Requiring every threshold condition keeps emergency alerts credible so drivers react immediately when highway boards flash.

sec03-card-sec03-F07.question_text: What core incident type is mandatory before law enforcement can trigger an Amber Alert?
sec03-card-sec03-F07.teaching_text: Ordinary runaway or custody disputes without an abduction do not meet Wyoming's emergency broadcast standard.

sec03-card-sec03-F08.question_text: What age requirement must an abducted child meet under Wyoming's Amber Alert rules?
sec03-card-sec03-F08.teaching_text: Anyone from infancy through age 17 qualifies under the minor age cap for an Amber Alert broadcast.

sec03-card-sec03-F09.question_text: What degree of threat must the abducted child face to activate an Amber Alert?
sec03-card-sec03-F09.teaching_text: Emergency broadcasts reserve rapid highway mobilization for cases posing imminent risk of severe injury or death.

sec03-card-sec03-F10.question_text: Why must investigators have enough descriptive details before launching an Amber Alert?
sec03-card-sec03-F10.teaching_text: Without a vehicle, plate, direction, or suspect description, highway motorists have nothing concrete to spot.

sec03-card-sec03-F11.question_text: What should drivers do whenever an Amber Alert flashes on overhead boards or radio?
sec03-card-sec03-F11.teaching_text: Alert eyes along wide-open Wyoming interstates regularly spot suspect vehicles hours from the abduction scene.

sec03-card-sec03-F12.question_text: How does WYDOT maintain driving histories for licensed motorists across Wyoming?
sec03-card-sec03-F12.teaching_text: Every Wyoming driver has a centralized electronic file tracking licensing status and traffic history statewide.

sec03-card-sec03-F13.question_text: Which two enforcement items appear on a motorist's computerized WYDOT driving record?
sec03-card-sec03-F13.teaching_text: Court traffic convictions and resulting WYDOT suspensions or revocations both post directly to your history.

sec03-card-sec03-F14.question_text: How can you pick up a copy of your own driving record at a local exam station?
sec03-card-sec03-F14.teaching_text: Presenting your driver license or legal identification with the record fee gets an official printout locally.

sec03-card-sec03-F15.question_text: Until what age may a legal parent or guardian obtain a minor child's Wyoming driving record?
sec03-card-sec03-F15.teaching_text: Once a young driver turns 18, privacy rules require the adult child's own signed release.

sec03-card-sec03-F16.question_text: What authorization must someone present to an examiner to obtain another adult's driving record?
sec03-card-sec03-F16.teaching_text: Employers or insurers seeking your record at a counter need your signed written release in hand.

sec03-card-sec03-F17.question_text: How can you order your own driving record from WYDOT without visiting an exam station?
sec03-card-sec03-F17.teaching_text: Sending a signed written request alongside the required fee lets out-of-town drivers obtain official records.

sec03-card-sec03-F18.question_text: What contact details must accompany a written driving-record request if you want to pay by credit card?
sec03-card-sec03-F18.teaching_text: Including your phone number and email address lets staff reach you securely to process card payment.

sec03-card-sec03-F19.question_text: What three commercial uses of driver data does the federal Driver's Privacy Protection Act block?
sec03-card-sec03-F19.teaching_text: Federal law stops WYDOT from selling or handing your personal driver file to telemarketers or junk mailers.

sec03-card-sec03-F20.question_text: Which five items on file count as protected personal information under the manual's privacy rules?
sec03-card-sec03-F20.teaching_text: Wallet portraits, electronic scans, autographs, telephone contacts, and health records stay shielded from unauthorized commercial eyes.

sec03-card-sec03-F21.question_text: Which three safety or status categories are not blocked from lawful release under the privacy discussion?
sec03-card-sec03-F21.teaching_text: While photos and medical notes stay private, crash reports, ticket convictions, and active credential status remain verifiable.

sec03-card-sec03-F22.question_text: What life-saving registration question appears on Wyoming driver-license and ID applications?
sec03-card-sec03-F22.teaching_text: Every license or ID application gives you a straightforward opt-in checkbox to join the donor registry.

sec03-card-sec03-F23.question_text: How does WYDOT share an applicant's choice to become an organ donor?
sec03-card-sec03-F23.teaching_text: Authorized electronic transmission keeps the official Donor Registry updated automatically without mailing extra forms.

sec03-card-sec03-F24.question_text: What extra approval is needed when an applicant under eighteen chooses to register as an organ donor?
sec03-card-sec03-F24.teaching_text: Minors under 18 can carry the donor mark once a parent or legal guardian signs consent.

sec03-card-sec03-F25.question_text: How is an organ donor's choice indicated on their finished Wyoming driver license or ID card?
sec03-card-sec03-F25.teaching_text: Printing the donor emblem right on the card alerts hospital teams immediately alongside electronic registry records.

sec03-card-sec03-R09.question_text: Why might an applicant request a voluntary medical-condition designation on a license or ID?
sec03-card-sec03-R09.teaching_text: Conditions like diabetes, epilepsy, or severe allergies matter urgently when a crash or episode prevents speaking.

sec03-card-sec03-R10.question_text: Where does a voluntary medical-alert designation appear once selected?
sec03-card-sec03-R10.teaching_text: Paramedics and officers checking a wallet card see the medical-alert notice immediately at the scene.

sec03-card-sec03-R11.question_text: Can you update or remove a voluntary medical-alert designation later, and how?
sec03-card-sec03-R11.teaching_text: Health needs evolve, so Driver Services lets cardholders modify or drop medical-alert info whenever needed.

sec03-card-sec03-R12.question_text: What voluntary conservation contribution can applicants make when applying for a Wyoming license or ID?
sec03-card-sec03-R12.teaching_text: Wyoming license and ID forms include a voluntary checkoff box supporting statewide wildlife conservation programs.

sec03-card-sec03-R13.question_text: How is a voluntary wildlife-conservation donation recorded and paid at the counter?
sec03-card-sec03-R13.teaching_text: You simply write your chosen dollar gift on the form and pay it alongside normal licensing fees.

sec03-card-sec03-R01.question_text: How long must a physical impairment last to qualify for a permanent disabled parking placard?
sec03-card-sec03-R01.teaching_text: Twelve months or longer separates permanent blue placards from shorter recovery permits.

sec03-card-sec03-R02.question_text: Up to how many months of impairment does a temporary disabled parking placard cover?
sec03-card-sec03-R02.teaching_text: Recovering from surgery or fractures lasting up to six months fits Wyoming's temporary disabled placard.

sec03-card-sec03-R03.question_text: Where can you pick up disabled parking placard application forms in person?
sec03-card-sec03-R03.teaching_text: Local WYDOT driver-license exam offices stock official disabled-placard forms across the state.

sec03-card-sec03-R04.question_text: Who must complete the medical certification on a disabled parking placard application?
sec03-card-sec03-R04.teaching_text: Self-certifying mobility limits is invalid because a physician must complete the medical portion of the form.

sec03-card-sec03-R05.question_text: Which form do you use if you want disabled metal license plates instead of only a hanging placard?
sec03-card-sec03-R05.teaching_text: One unified placard application handles both requests once you check the option requesting disabled license plates.

sec03-card-sec03-R06.question_text: If an eligible person receives disabled license plates, how many hanging placards may they also hold?
sec03-card-sec03-R06.teaching_text: Pairing one portable placard with your plated vehicle(s) covers you when riding in someone else's car.

sec03-card-sec03-R07.question_text: How many disabled placards may an eligible person receive when choosing zero disabled license plates?
sec03-card-sec03-R07.teaching_text: Skipping disabled metal plates lets an eligible applicant hold two portable placards for multi-car households.

sec03-card-sec03-R08.question_text: How much does Wyoming charge an eligible applicant for disabled parking placards?
sec03-card-sec03-R08.teaching_text: Wyoming provides eligible disabled parking placards at zero cost so mobility access carries no fee barrier.

sec04-card-sec04-F01.question_text: What chemical-test alcohol concentration following a DWUI arrest triggers an Administrative Per Se suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-F01.teaching_text: Testing at 0.08 percent or higher after a DWUI arrest launches WYDOT's administrative suspension before court ever meets.

sec04-card-sec04-F02.question_text: Does having your criminal DWUI charge dismissed in court cancel the Administrative Per Se suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-F02.teaching_text: Administrative licensing action and criminal prosecution run on separate legal tracks, so a court dismissal won't erase Per Se.

sec04-card-sec04-F03.question_text: How long does an Administrative Per Se suspension last in Wyoming?
sec04-card-sec04-F03.teaching_text: Keep 90 days locked in for Wyoming's Administrative Per Se suspension following a 0.08-plus arrest test.

sec04-card-sec04-F04.question_text: If a court DWUI conviction follows, how is time already served on the Administrative Per Se suspension treated?
sec04-card-sec04-F04.teaching_text: Crediting administrative suspension days already served prevents doubling up two separate 90-day suspensions for one arrest.

sec04-card-sec04-F05.question_text: When does an Administrative Per Se suspension take effect after the officer hands over the notice and temporary license?
sec04-card-sec04-F05.teaching_text: That 30-day window lets an un-suspended driver arrange transportation or request a timely hearing before suspension starts.

sec04-card-sec04-F06.question_text: Which two administrative procedures does the arresting officer's suspension form explain how to request?
sec04-card-sec04-F06.teaching_text: Read the temporary form immediately because both probationary relief and contested hearings carry tight postmark deadlines.

sec04-card-sec04-F07.question_text: Which two conditions disqualify an otherwise eligible driver from getting limited privileges during an Administrative Per Se suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-F07.teaching_text: Holding a probationary license within the past five years or facing mandatory ignition interlock blocks probationary relief.

sec04-card-sec04-F08.question_text: What two steps are required to reinstate your license after an Administrative Per Se suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-F08.teaching_text: Privileges never snap back automatically on day 91 until all recorded actions finish and the reinstatement fee is paid.

sec04-card-sec04-F09.question_text: What court outcome triggers Wyoming's criminal DWUI suspension category?
sec04-card-sec04-F09.teaching_text: Unlike arrest-based Per Se action, this mandatory suspension category follows an actual court DWUI conviction.

sec04-card-sec04-F10.question_text: Under which Wyoming statute can a DWUI case result in deferred prosecution?
sec04-card-sec04-F10.teaching_text: Even when a court grants statutory deferred prosecution under 7-13-301, licensing and high-BAC interlock rules can still attach.

sec04-card-sec04-F11.question_text: What lookback window and suspension length apply to a first court DWUI offense?
sec04-card-sec04-F11.teaching_text: Wyoming measures DWUI repeat status across a 10-year window and sets a 90-day suspension for a first offense.

sec04-card-sec04-F12.question_text: How do the Administrative Per Se suspension and first-offense court DWUI suspension interact?
sec04-card-sec04-F12.teaching_text: Serving the 90-day Administrative Per Se suspension satisfies that same suspension span on a first DWUI.

sec04-card-sec04-F13.question_text: Who may qualify for limited driving privileges after a first DWUI conviction?
sec04-card-sec04-F13.teaching_text: Just like Per Se, a clean five-year probationary history and no high-BAC interlock requirement are required.

sec04-card-sec04-F14.question_text: At what arrest BAC on a first DWUI must the driver hold an interlock-restricted license for six months?
sec04-card-sec04-F14.teaching_text: Reaching 0.15 percent BAC, nearly double 0.08, locks in a mandatory six-month ignition-interlock license on a first offense.

sec04-card-sec04-F15.question_text: What suspension or interlock option satisfies the first item on Wyoming's first-DWUI reinstatement checklist?
sec04-card-sec04-F15.teaching_text: Drivers under 0.15 finish their suspension, whereas 0.15-plus drivers apply for an interlock license with installation proof.

sec04-card-sec04-F16.question_text: Which insurance filing and payment complete the first-DWUI reinstatement checklist?
sec04-card-sec04-F16.teaching_text: Every court DWUI reinstatement adds three-year SR-22 proof of insurance alongside the state reinstatement fee.

sec04-card-sec04-F17.question_text: What suspension length applies to a second DWUI offense within ten years?
sec04-card-sec04-F17.teaching_text: Picking up a second DWUI inside ten years quadruples suspension length from 90 days to one full year.

sec04-card-sec04-F18.question_text: On a second DWUI where the 90-day Per Se suspension was served or started, how much suspension is added?
sec04-card-sec04-F18.teaching_text: Ninety administrative days plus nine additional court months add up to the full twelve-month second-offense year.

sec04-card-sec04-F19.question_text: How long must a driver hold an interlock-restricted license after a second alcohol-involved DWUI conviction?
sec04-card-sec04-F19.teaching_text: Any second alcohol-related DWUI mandates a full year on ignition interlock regardless of exact arrest BAC.

sec04-card-sec04-F20.question_text: What licensing penalty hits upon a third DWUI conviction inside a ten-year span?
sec04-card-sec04-F20.teaching_text: A third offense escalates from temporary suspension to full three-year license revocation canceling your credential.

sec04-card-sec04-F21.question_text: What ignition-interlock term applies upon a fourth or subsequent alcohol-involved DWUI conviction?
sec04-card-sec04-F21.teaching_text: Four alcohol DWUI convictions trigger a lifetime interlock mandate unless a court later grants relief.

sec04-card-sec04-F22.question_text: How soon after conviction may a driver with a lifetime interlock mandate petition the court for removal?
sec04-card-sec04-F22.teaching_text: Five clean years after the conviction date is the earliest statutory mark to ask a judge to lift lifetime interlock.

sec04-card-sec04-F23.question_text: What completion or interlock option starts the reinstatement checklist after a third or later DWUI?
sec04-card-sec04-F23.teaching_text: Applicants either complete all suspension and revocation periods or qualify for an interlock-restricted card with installation proof.

sec04-card-sec04-F24.question_text: Which financial-responsibility form and payment are required on the third-or-later DWUI checklist?
sec04-card-sec04-F24.teaching_text: Repeat DWUI relicensing always requires active SR-22 insurance certification and full reinstatement fee payment.

sec04-card-sec04-F25.question_text: What clinical screening is required to reinstate after a third or subsequent DWUI?
sec04-card-sec04-F25.teaching_text: Before WYDOT restores privileges after three-plus DWUIs, a professional substance evaluation must assess dependency risk.

sec04-card-sec04-F26.question_text: Beyond an evaluation, what program milestone is required for third-or-later DWUI reinstatement?
sec04-card-sec04-F26.teaching_text: Evaluation alone isn't enough because repeat offenders must document successful completion of a treatment program.

sec04-card-sec04-F27.question_text: What driving-ability requirement appears on the third-or-later DWUI checklist unless waived by clean interlock history?
sec04-card-sec04-F27.teaching_text: Because revocation cancels your license outright, WYDOT requires proving safe operation again unless the interlock waiver applies.

sec04-card-sec04-F28.question_text: What ongoing restriction and compliance duty can attach when relicensed after repeat DWUIs?
sec04-card-sec04-F28.teaching_text: Relicensed repeat offenders can carry a strict no-alcohol-or-substance-offense restriction alongside mandatory counselor follow-through.

sec04-card-sec04-F29.question_text: What reward applies if a repeat-DWUI driver holds an interlock-restricted license with zero violations?
sec04-card-sec04-F29.teaching_text: Completing your interlock term violation-free can excuse both the repeat-DWUI re-examination and the extra restriction.

sec04-card-sec04-F30.question_text: At what alcohol concentration does a driver under twenty-one in actual physical control face youthful-driver DWUI suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-F30.teaching_text: Even sitting in physical control of a parked car at 0.02 percent BAC triggers Wyoming's under-21 suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-F31.question_text: How long is the license suspension for a first youthful-driver DWUI offense?
sec04-card-sec04-F31.teaching_text: Even a first under-21 violation at 0.02 percent BAC benches your driving privileges for a full 90 days.

sec04-card-sec04-F32.question_text: What lookback period and suspension length apply to a second or later youthful-driver DWUI?
sec04-card-sec04-F32.teaching_text: Watch the lookback trap because repeat youthful DWUI uses a 2-year window and doubles suspension to six months.

sec04-card-sec04-F33.question_text: When can a suspended driver in the youthful-driver DWUI category qualify for limited privileges?
sec04-card-sec04-F33.teaching_text: Probationary driving relief stays off-limits if you used one in the last five years or triggered interlock.

sec04-card-sec04-F34.question_text: What arrest BAC on a first youthful-driver offense triggers a six-month interlock-restricted license?
sec04-card-sec04-F34.teaching_text: Just like adult court DWUI, testing at 0.15 percent or higher mandates six months on ignition interlock.

sec04-card-sec04-F35.question_text: What interlock requirement follows a second alcohol-involved youthful-driver DWUI conviction?
sec04-card-sec04-F35.teaching_text: A second under-21 alcohol DWUI conviction locks in one full year on an interlock-restricted license.

sec04-card-sec04-F36.question_text: How does the Wyoming manual define the driving conduct behind a reckless-driving conviction?
sec04-card-sec04-F36.teaching_text: Driving with deliberate, reckless indifference toward human safety or property crosses from ordinary speeding into a suspension-triggering conviction.

sec04-card-sec04-F37.question_text: What lookback window and suspension length apply to a first reckless-driving conviction?
sec04-card-sec04-F37.teaching_text: Keep lookbacks straight by pairing adult DWUI with 10 years and reckless driving with 5 years.

sec04-card-sec04-F38.question_text: When may a driver convicted of a first reckless-driving offense obtain limited driving privileges?
sec04-card-sec04-F38.teaching_text: If you hold no other disqualifiers and haven't used a probationary card in five years, limited relief is possible.

sec04-card-sec04-F39.question_text: What suspension length follows a second reckless-driving conviction within five years?
sec04-card-sec04-F39.teaching_text: A second reckless conviction inside five years doubles your bench time from 90 days to six months.

sec04-card-sec04-F40.question_text: Are limited driving privileges still possible after a second reckless-driving offense within five years?
sec04-card-sec04-F40.teaching_text: Only an otherwise eligible driver who did not already burn their five-year probationary license can qualify.

sec04-card-sec04-F41.question_text: Which three requirements apply to reinstate your license after a second reckless-driving offense?
sec04-card-sec04-F41.teaching_text: Notice that a second reckless conviction adds mandatory SR-22 insurance filing on top of suspension completion and fees.

sec04-card-sec04-F42.question_text: What penalty hits upon a third or subsequent reckless-driving offense within five years?
sec04-card-sec04-F42.teaching_text: Three reckless convictions in five years trigger a full one-year license revocation canceling your credential.

sec04-card-sec04-F43.question_text: Can a driver revoked for a third or later reckless-driving offense get limited driving privileges?
sec04-card-sec04-F43.teaching_text: Revocation for three-time reckless driving completely bars any probationary or limited-privilege license.

sec04-card-sec04-F44.question_text: Which four steps are required to get relicensed after a third or later reckless-driving revocation?
sec04-card-sec04-F44.teaching_text: Beyond serving the revocation, filing SR-22, and paying fees, you must pass a safe-driving re-examination.

sec04-card-sec04-F45.question_text: What vehicle-related alcohol offense involving someone under twenty-one triggers a dedicated suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-F45.teaching_text: Driving or even riding in a vehicle with intent to furnish liquor or beer to a minor suspends your license.

sec04-card-sec04-F46.question_text: How long is the license suspension for transporting liquor with intent to furnish a minor?
sec04-card-sec04-F46.teaching_text: Supplying underage alcohol from a motor vehicle costs a full twelve-month suspension on the first conviction.

sec04-card-sec04-F47.question_text: Who may qualify for limited privileges during a transporting-liquor-to-a-minor suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-F47.teaching_text: Applicants without another disqualifier or a probationary license in the past five years may request limited relief.

sec04-card-sec04-F48.question_text: What two requirements apply to reinstate after a transporting-liquor-to-a-minor suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-F48.teaching_text: Complete every recorded suspension term and submit the reinstatement fee before driving again.

sec04-card-sec04-R01.question_text: What interstate compact suspension triggers when a court reports you failed to satisfy a traffic citation?
sec04-card-sec04-R01.teaching_text: Ignoring a traffic ticket, whether written in Wyoming or another member state, triggers an NRVC license suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-R02.question_text: Under the Non-Resident Violator Compact, which state actually suspends the driver's license?
sec04-card-sec04-R02.teaching_text: If you ignore an out-of-state ticket, that court notifies WYDOT, and your licensing state suspends your credential.

sec04-card-sec04-R03.question_text: How long does a citation-related Non-Resident Violator Compact suspension remain active?
sec04-card-sec04-R03.teaching_text: Unlike fixed 90-day suspensions, an unanswered-ticket suspension runs indefinitely until resolved and paid.

sec04-card-sec04-R04.question_text: Can you obtain limited probationary driving privileges during a Non-Resident Violator Compact suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-R04.teaching_text: Because you can end the hold anytime by satisfying the court citation, probationary licenses are unavailable.

sec04-card-sec04-R05.question_text: What happens if the court sends satisfaction notice before the citation-related suspension start date arrives?
sec04-card-sec04-R05.teaching_text: Settling the overdue ticket within the 30-day pre-start window wipes the pending suspension off your record fee-free.

sec04-card-sec04-R06.question_text: What two items are required once a citation-related suspension has already taken effect?
sec04-card-sec04-R06.teaching_text: Waiting past the effective date costs you the state reinstatement fee on top of clearing the court ticket.

sec04-card-sec04-R07.question_text: How many moving-violation convictions within twelve months trigger a ninety-day Wyoming suspension notice?
sec04-card-sec04-R07.teaching_text: Three moving tickets put you on the brink because a fourth inside twelve months launches a 90-day suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-R08.question_text: What happens for each additional moving violation after the fourth within that same twelve-month window?
sec04-card-sec04-R08.teaching_text: Every subsequent moving conviction inside those twelve months stacks another 90-day suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-R09.question_text: Does Wyoming's moving-violation twelve-month lookback count from the ticket offense date or the court conviction date?
sec04-card-sec04-R09.teaching_text: Delaying your court hearing cannot game the 12-month clock because WYDOT counts backward using actual offense dates.

sec04-card-sec04-R10.question_text: How does the manual define a moving violation, and do license-restriction convictions count?
sec04-card-sec04-R10.teaching_text: Any convicted control offense while rolling, including driving without required glasses or outside teen hours, counts as a moving strike.

sec04-card-sec04-R11.question_text: What triggers Wyoming's compulsory-insurance license suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-R11.teaching_text: Getting convicted in court of driving without mandatory liability coverage suspends your driving privileges.

sec04-card-sec04-R12.question_text: Until what document is filed does a compulsory-insurance suspension stay in force?
sec04-card-sec04-R12.teaching_text: Buying an ordinary policy card isn't enough until your insurer files an official SR-22 certificate with WYDOT.

sec04-card-sec04-R13.question_text: Are limited probationary privileges available during a compulsory-insurance suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-R13.teaching_text: WYDOT will not grant probationary driving privileges when the underlying issue is lacking liability insurance.

sec04-card-sec04-R14.question_text: What happens if you file an SR-22 before a compulsory-insurance suspension's effective date?
sec04-card-sec04-R14.teaching_text: Filing your SR-22 during the pre-start notice window deletes the compulsory-insurance suspension before it begins.

sec04-card-sec04-R15.question_text: What two items are required if you wait until after a compulsory-insurance suspension starts?
sec04-card-sec04-R15.teaching_text: Once the suspension takes effect, reinstating requires both the insurer's SR-22 filing and the reinstatement fee.

sec04-card-sec04-R16.question_text: What licensing action can result from displaying or using someone else's driver license or ID card?
sec04-card-sec04-R16.teaching_text: Flashing a friend's or sibling's ID puts your own real Wyoming driving privileges under unlawful-use suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-R17.question_text: What happens if you possess a driver license or ID card that has been altered or tampered with?
sec04-card-sec04-R17.teaching_text: Merely possessing a doctored birth date or tampered card is enough to suspend your driving privileges.

sec04-card-sec04-R18.question_text: Is it legal to lend your own Wyoming license or ID card to a friend for identification?
sec04-card-sec04-R18.teaching_text: Both the borrower and the person who lent out the card face unlawful-use penalties.

sec04-card-sec04-R19.question_text: What rule governs making false statements, giving a fake name, or hiding facts on a license or ID application?
sec04-card-sec04-R19.teaching_text: Hiding an out-of-state suspension or writing fictitious details on an application is an unlawful fraud offense.

sec04-card-sec04-R20.question_text: Which four personal identifiers belonging to someone else is it unlawful to put on a license or ID application?
sec04-card-sec04-R20.teaching_text: Applying with another person's name, residential address, Social Security number, or birth date violates identity law.

sec04-card-sec04-R21.question_text: What administrative penalties can hit someone who misuses or lends a driver license or ID card?
sec04-card-sec04-R21.teaching_text: WYDOT can cancel the misused credential, slap a 90-day suspension on the user or lender, or impose both.

sec04-card-sec04-R22.question_text: What dollar amount and duration of unpaid child support trigger a DFS license suspension notice?
sec04-card-sec04-R22.teaching_text: Falling at least $5,000 behind for 90 consecutive days prompts Family Services to trigger license suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-R23.question_text: What DFS clearance and WYDOT payment are required to end a child-support suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-R23.teaching_text: Family Services must notify WYDOT of full payment or an approved payment plan, plus you pay the reinstatement fee.

sec04-card-sec04-R24.question_text: How long is the suspension for a first moving-violation conviction committed on a restricted Class RC license?
sec04-card-sec04-R24.teaching_text: Restricted Class RC teen drivers face an immediate 90-day suspension on their very first moving ticket.

sec04-card-sec04-R25.question_text: What suspension length follows a second or later moving conviction while holding a restricted Class RC license?
sec04-card-sec04-R25.teaching_text: A second moving violation on a restricted Class RC card jumps from 90 days to a full one-year suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-R26.question_text: How many days is an intermediate license suspended for violating passenger, seat-belt, or curfew restrictions?
sec04-card-sec04-R26.teaching_text: Compare teen penalties carefully so you pair Class RC moving tickets with 90 days and intermediate breaches with 30 days.

sec04-card-sec04-R27.question_text: What extra suspension hits a driver under twenty-one caught driving while suspended, revoked, or canceled?
sec04-card-sec04-R27.teaching_text: Driving while sidelined under 21 tacks an extra 30-day suspension onto your existing penalty.

sec04-card-sec04-R28.question_text: When does Wyoming impose an uninsured-accident suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-R28.teaching_text: Being involved in a collision where active liability coverage at crash time cannot be verified triggers suspension.

sec04-card-sec04-R29.question_text: What notarized statement from the other crash parties can resolve an uninsured-accident suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-R29.teaching_text: Other involved parties can sign a notarized release confirming either you aren't held liable or restitution is paid.

sec04-card-sec04-R30.question_text: How does a conditional release resolve an uninsured crash when damages aren't paid upfront in full?
sec04-card-sec04-R30.teaching_text: Both the uninsured driver and other crash parties sign a notarized agreement setting installment payment terms.

sec04-card-sec04-R31.question_text: How is the cash-deposit amount calculated if an uninsured driver posts security instead of a release?
sec04-card-sec04-R31.teaching_text: Know the exact deposit formula combining total property damage plus $25,000 for each injured person.

sec04-card-sec04-R32.question_text: When and under what condition can an uninsured-crash cash deposit be refunded?
sec04-card-sec04-R32.teaching_text: WYDOT holds the cash security for one year post-crash and refunds it only if no court judgments stand against you.

sec04-card-sec04-R33.question_text: What option opens one year after an uninsured crash if you could neither get a release nor post cash?
sec04-card-sec04-R33.teaching_text: After sitting out a full year with zero unsatisfied crash judgments, a signed notarized affidavit satisfies that step.

sec04-card-sec04-R34.question_text: Alongside a release, deposit, or one-year affidavit, what two extra items are required after an uninsured-crash suspension?
sec04-card-sec04-R34.teaching_text: Settling crash damages alone isn't enough until you also pay the reinstatement fee and file future SR-22 proof.

sec04-card-sec04-R35.question_text: What formal review does an eligible suspended driver request to seek a limited probationary license?
sec04-card-sec04-R35.teaching_text: Asking for a Record Review lets WYDOT evaluate your history for a limited probationary driving credential.

sec04-card-sec04-R36.question_text: Within how many days of the suspension notice date must a written Record Review request and fee be postmarked?
sec04-card-sec04-R36.teaching_text: Missing the strict 20-day postmark window from the notice date forfeits your chance at a Record Review.

sec04-card-sec04-R37.question_text: How often can a Wyoming motorist receive a probationary limited-privilege license?
sec04-card-sec04-R37.teaching_text: Wyoming treats a probationary license as a once-in-five-years lifeline rather than a repeatable pass.

sec04-card-sec04-R38.question_text: What form, payment, and postmark deadline apply to requesting a Contested Case Hearing?
sec04-card-sec04-R38.teaching_text: Both Record Reviews and Contested Case Hearings share the exact same written-plus-fee 20-day postmark deadline.

sec04-card-sec04-R39.question_text: How does revocation affect your driver license, and what is required before relicensing afterward?
sec04-card-sec04-R39.teaching_text: Suspension benches a license temporarily, whereas revocation terminates it and requires passing a WYDOT investigation afterward.

sec04-card-sec04-R40.question_text: Which repeat impaired-driving milestone appears on the handbook's revocation list?
sec04-card-sec04-R40.teaching_text: Reaching a third DWUI shifts the penalty from suspension into full license revocation.

sec04-card-sec04-R41.question_text: Which repeat reckless-driving milestone triggers license revocation?
sec04-card-sec04-R41.teaching_text: Accumulating three reckless-driving convictions escalates your penalty from temporary suspension into full mandatory license revocation.

sec04-card-sec04-R42.question_text: What crash-scene offense causes license revocation on the very first conviction?
sec04-card-sec04-R42.teaching_text: Fleeing a collision involving bodily injury revokes your Wyoming license immediately upon conviction.

sec04-card-sec04-R43.question_text: How does a conviction for homicide by vehicle affect your Wyoming driver license?
sec04-card-sec04-R43.teaching_text: Causing a death criminally behind the wheel sits squarely on Wyoming's mandatory revocation list.

sec04-card-sec04-R44.question_text: How does a felony conviction tied directly to the manner of driving affect your license?
sec04-card-sec04-R44.teaching_text: Any felony resulting directly from how a motor vehicle was operated revokes driving privileges.

sec04-card-sec04-R45.question_text: What exactly is an SR-22, and who files it with WYDOT?
sec04-card-sec04-R45.teaching_text: An SR-22 is not just a glovebox card because your insurance company files that certificate directly with WYDOT.

sec04-card-sec04-R46.question_text: How long must financial-responsibility proof remain on file for covered violations?
sec04-card-sec04-R46.teaching_text: Dropping coverage even a month before the full three-year SR-22 period ends re-suspends your privileges.

sec04-card-sec04-R47.question_text: What must an insurance company do if a policy backed by an SR-22 gets canceled?
sec04-card-sec04-R47.teaching_text: Automatic insurer cancellation notices alert WYDOT immediately if an SR-22 driver lets payments lapse.

sec04-card-sec04-R48.question_text: What happens when your mandatory suspension calendar ends if your required SR-22 is still missing?
sec04-card-sec04-R48.teaching_text: Finishing your 90-day or one-year clock never restores legal driving until the SR-22 lands on file.

sec04-card-sec04-R49.question_text: How many days after WYDOT mails an order, or an officer serves it, does a suspension or revocation generally begin?
sec04-card-sec04-R49.teaching_text: Unless tacked onto an already running suspension, orders generally start 30 days after mailing or hand delivery.

sec04-card-sec04-R50.question_text: Who pays the cost of installing a required ignition-interlock device?
sec04-card-sec04-R50.teaching_text: Every installation, calibration, and lease dollar for mandatory ignition interlock falls on the applicant.

sec04-card-sec04-R51.question_text: When does the interlock summary require six months of device use on a first DWUI or deferred prosecution?
sec04-card-sec04-R51.teaching_text: Even a deferred prosecution carries six months of ignition interlock when administrative testing showed 0.15 percent or higher.

sec04-card-sec04-R52.question_text: What interlock term does the device summary list after a second alcohol-involved DWUI conviction?
sec04-card-sec04-R52.teaching_text: Picking up a second alcohol-related DWUI conviction carries a mandatory one-year ignition-interlock requirement before unrestricted licensing.

sec04-card-sec04-R53.question_text: How does the device summary state the interlock rule and removal window for a fourth or later alcohol DWUI?
sec04-card-sec04-R53.teaching_text: Four alcohol DWUIs trigger lifetime interlock with the option to petition court five years post-conviction.

sec04-card-sec04-R54.question_text: What insurance filing must accompany any alcohol-related conviction that requires ignition interlock?
sec04-card-sec04-R54.teaching_text: Every alcohol conviction triggering ignition interlock also requires maintaining SR-22 proof with WYDOT.

sec04-card-sec04-R55.question_text: Who must install ignition interlock, and which vehicles must carry the device?
sec04-card-sec04-R55.teaching_text: DIY installs are invalid, and borrowing an unequipped family car violates the every-vehicle-driven rule.

sec04-card-sec04-R57.question_text: Can you get an interlock-restricted license while suspended or revoked in any state for a separate non-DWUI reason?
sec04-card-sec04-R57.teaching_text: Unpaid tickets, child support, or uninsured crashes in any state must clear before an interlock license can issue.

sec04-card-sec04-R58.question_text: What testing obligation applies when applying for an interlock-restricted license?
sec04-card-sec04-R58.teaching_text: Applicants whose credentials expired or were revoked must still pass required WYDOT exams to get the interlock card.

sec04-card-sec04-R59.question_text: Can a driver simply sit out the calendar without driving to skip holding a required interlock-restricted license?
sec04-card-sec04-R59.teaching_text: Waiting years without a license won't bypass interlock because no other license issues until the interlock term is served.

sec04-card-sec04-R60.question_text: What court-ordered program lets an eligible driver apply for a restricted license instead of ignition interlock?
sec04-card-sec04-R60.teaching_text: When a judge orders Wyoming's 24-over-7 Sobriety Program in place of interlock, WYDOT can issue a matching restricted license.

sec05-card-sec05-F01.question_text: Who does Wyoming's general safety-belt rule cover inside a vehicle?
sec05-card-sec05-F01.teaching_text: Leaving even one rider unbuckled turns that passenger into a deadly projectile that can injure everyone else during a sudden crash.

sec05-card-sec05-F02.question_text: Who holds legal responsibility for making sure riders follow the safety-belt law?
sec05-card-sec05-F02.teaching_text: Test questions check whether you know the person behind the wheel answers for passenger belt compliance before shifting out of park.

sec05-card-sec05-F03.question_text: How must children be secured when riding in a vehicle?
sec05-card-sec05-F03.teaching_text: Adult seat belts built for grown frames cannot hold small bodies safely, so children need an appropriate restraint fastened properly.

sec05-card-sec05-F04.question_text: Where and how tightly should a lap belt rest across your lower body?
sec05-card-sec05-F04.teaching_text: Strong pelvic bones can absorb crash forces that would otherwise crush internal organs if the strap rides up loose.

sec05-card-sec05-F05.question_text: Over which part of the torso should a lap belt never rest?
sec05-card-sec05-F05.teaching_text: A strap sitting high over soft abdominal tissue slams straight into vital organs during hard braking or a collision.

sec05-card-sec05-F06.question_text: How much freedom of movement should the driver's shoulder belt allow?
sec05-card-sec05-F06.teaching_text: Your upper strap should hold your chest secure while still letting you comfortably reach essential switches and steering controls.

sec05-card-sec05-F07.question_text: Is it ever proper to wear the shoulder belt without the lap belt?
sec05-card-sec05-F07.teaching_text: Wearing only the upper strap lets your lower body submarine forward in a crash and risks severe neck or chest injury.

sec05-card-sec05-F08.question_text: Which age group of children is covered by Wyoming's child-restraint guide?
sec05-card-sec05-F08.teaching_text: Exam items often test the exact birthday cutoff, which applies until a child actually reaches age nine.

sec05-card-sec05-F09.question_text: Which drivers and passenger vehicles fall under the child-restraint guide?
sec05-card-sec05-F09.teaching_text: Borrowing, leasing, or renting a noncommercial car never excuses a driver from strapping young passengers into approved restraints.

sec05-card-sec05-F10.question_text: Do Wyoming's child-restraint rules apply only to state residents or to visitors too?
sec05-card-sec05-F10.teaching_text: Out-of-state plates offer zero immunity on Wyoming roads when a child under nine rides without proper protection.

sec05-card-sec05-F11.question_text: Where must a covered child sit, and what two situations allow using the front seat?
sec05-card-sec05-F11.teaching_text: Children belong in back unless the vehicle has only one seating row or other kids already fill every rear belt.

sec05-card-sec05-F12.question_text: Where must a rear-facing infant restraint never be positioned?
sec05-card-sec05-F12.teaching_text: An inflating front airbag strikes the back of a rear-facing carrier at explosive speed directly behind the baby's head.

sec05-card-sec05-F13.question_text: What directions govern how a child is fastened inside a child restraint?
sec05-card-sec05-F13.teaching_text: Loose harness straps or misplaced chest clips defeat crash testing unless you follow the seat maker's exact harnessing steps.

sec05-card-sec05-F14.question_text: What rule governs how the child restraint itself is anchored into the vehicle?
sec05-card-sec05-F14.teaching_text: Even a tightly harnessed child stays at risk if the carrier base is anchored wrong instead of matching manufacturer steps.

sec05-card-sec05-F15.question_text: Which federal motor vehicle safety standard number must an approved child restraint meet?
sec05-card-sec05-F15.teaching_text: Checking the label for standard two hundred thirteen confirms the seat passed federal crash-performance requirements rather than novelty use.

sec05-card-sec05-F16.question_text: How is child-restraint nonuse or misuse classified for a traffic stop?
sec05-card-sec05-F16.teaching_text: Officers do not need another traffic violation first because an unrestrained or misused child seat alone justifies pulling you over.

sec05-card-sec05-F17.question_text: What is the maximum fine for a first child-restraint violation?
sec05-card-sec05-F17.teaching_text: Permit tests pair primary enforcement questions with exact dollar caps so you remember sixty dollars tops the first citation.

sec05-card-sec05-F18.question_text: When must the court waive the fine on a first child-restraint offense?
sec05-card-sec05-F18.teaching_text: The law prioritizes getting kids protected right away by dropping the first fine once you prove you obtained an approved seat.

sec05-card-sec05-F19.question_text: What is the maximum fine for a second or later child-restraint offense?
sec05-card-sec05-F19.teaching_text: A repeat violation loses first-time leniency and raises the maximum court fine to one hundred ten dollars.

sec05-card-sec05-F20.question_text: When is a child under nine exempt from needing a separate child restraint based on belt fit?
sec05-card-sec05-F20.teaching_text: Once standard straps fit collarbone, chest, and hips cleanly without threatening neck, face, or abdomen in a stop, no booster is required.

sec05-card-sec05-F21.question_text: What paperwork is required in the vehicle for a medical exemption from a child restraint?
sec05-card-sec05-F21.teaching_text: Leaving the signed physician note at home leaves you without valid proof during a roadside child-restraint check.

sec05-card-sec05-F22.question_text: How do child-restraint rules treat a vehicle built at the factory without safety belts?
